maxhodak.en: Speed and iteration rate are key; custom internal software beats commercial ERP; AI multiplies teams, not replaces.
maxhodak.zh: 速度和迭代速率是关键；自研内部软件优于商用 ERP；AI 是团队倍增器而非替代品。

maxhodak.en: Brain is a computer; retinal implants are BCI proof-of-concept; substrate independence reduces fragility.
maxhodak.zh: 大脑是计算机；视网膜植入物是脑机接口的概念验证；基质独立性可减少脆弱性。

iansilber.en: Designers must work closely with the model, understanding its capabilities and limitations to productize it; the model is the core product.
iansilber.zh: 设计师必须与模型紧密合作，理解其能力与局限以将其产品化；模型本身是核心产品。

iansilber.en: AI is already an incredible product designer, but humans remain essential for understanding user needs and having a point of view.
iansilber.zh: AI 已经是出色的产品设计师，但人类在理解用户需求和持有观点方面仍然不可或缺。

iansilber.en: The traditional design process is no longer viable; speed and rapid iteration with AI tools are key.
iansilber.zh: 传统设计流程已不可行；借助 AI 工具的速度和快速迭代是关键。

iansilber.en: Designers are not behind; starting today gives you a leg up due to the early stage of AI evolution.
iansilber.zh: 设计师并未落后；由于 AI 发展尚早，今天开始反而让你领先大多数人。

iansilber.en: The future may see more designers than engineers, reversing traditional ratios.
iansilber.zh: 未来设计师数量可能超过工程师，扭转传统比例。

dylanpatel.en: Initially focused on compute scaling bottlenecks, highlighting semiconductor supply chain and memory constraints.
dylanpatel.zh: 最初关注算力扩展瓶颈，强调半导体供应链和内存限制。

dylanpatel.en: Shifted to inference as a massive future market, emphasizing hardware-software co-design and memory bandwidth innovations.
dylanpatel.zh: 转向推理作为巨大未来市场，强调软硬件协同设计和内存带宽创新。

dylanpatel.en: Stressed rapid AI cost improvement and memory/CPU demand surges due to reasoning and agentic workflows.
dylanpatel.zh: 强调 AI 成本快速下降，以及推理和智能体工作流带来的内存和 CPU 需求激增。

dylanpatel.en: Observed AI spending plateauing, with agents becoming coworkers and regulatory delays affecting releases.
dylanpatel.zh: 观察到 AI 支出趋于平稳，智能体成为同事，监管延迟影响发布。

dylanpatel.en: Consistently highlighted compute and memory as key bottlenecks, with a contrarian view on cost and value.
dylanpatel.zh: 始终强调算力和内存是关键瓶颈，并对成本和价值持反共识观点。

sutton.en: Scaling is easy; finding methods that scale is the hard part. Backprop doesn't solve representation learning.
sutton.zh: 2024 年，萨顿强调 Scaling 本身容易，难的是找到能规模化的方法；反向传播并未解决表征学习问题。

sutton.en: AI should be permissionless and decentralized; control is dangerous. We should not align AI to human goals.
sutton.zh: 2024 至 2025 年间，他主张 AI 应去中心化、无需许可地发展，控制是危险的，不应将 AI 对齐到人类目标。

sutton.en: Reinforcement learning is the core of intelligence; LLMs lack world models and don't learn from experience.
sutton.zh: 2025 年，他提出强化学习是智能的核心，大语言模型缺乏世界模型，且不通过经验学习。

sutton.en: AGI needs a general architecture with no domain knowledge, learning from runtime experience via open-ended abstraction.
sutton.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他主张 AGI 需要无领域知识的通用架构，通过开放式抽象从运行时经验中学习。

sutton.en: Continual learning is essential; synthetic data is a mistake. LLMs stop learning after training, limiting true intelligence.
sutton.zh: 2026 年，他强调持续学习至关重要，合成数据是错误方向；大语言模型训练后停止学习，限制了真正的智能。

traviskalanick.en: Digitizing the physical world, treating atoms like bits, guides long-term vision; industrial AI automates entire industries one at a time.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他提出将物理世界数字化、把原子当作比特来处理是长期愿景的框架；工业 AI 正逐个行业地实现自动化。

traviskalanick.en: Industrial AI is the next industrial revolution; entrepreneurs must fight for the best idea and resist complacency.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他强调工业 AI 是下一次工业革命，创业者必须为最佳想法而战，并警惕自满。

traviskalanick.en: Specialized machines, not humanoids, are the answer for industrial-scale tasks; efficiency leads to network effects.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他主张工业级任务应使用专用机器而非人形机器人，效率优势会带来网络效应。

traviskalanick.en: Entrepreneurship is about resilience and culture; the idea is secondary to the person executing it.
traviskalanick.zh: 始终认为创业的核心在于韧性和文化，想法的重要性次于执行者。

traviskalanick.en: Capitalism is the right to start a business freely; anti-capitalism restricts that; real estate is key in physical AI.
traviskalanick.zh: 2026 年 8 月，他重申资本主义是自由创业的权利，反资本主义则限制之；并指出房地产在物理 AI 中的关键地位。

joonpark.en: LLMs encode human behavior; simulations predict actions 85% as accurately as self-replication, but need real-world data to capture diversity.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为大语言模型能编码人类行为，模拟预测准确率达 85%，但需真实数据以捕捉多样性。

joonpark.en: Shift from prediction to shaping the future; simulation enables counterfactual reasoning and testing second-order impacts, not just forecasting.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 6 月至 8 月，观点从预测转向塑造未来，强调模拟的反事实推理和二阶影响测试。

joonpark.en: Simulations must model 'dumb' humans with biases, not super-rational machines; post-training with RCT data improves accuracy to 85%.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调模拟需建模有偏见的“普通”人类，而非超级理性机器；用随机对照试验数据后训练可提升准确率至 85%。

joonpark.en: Vision: simulate 8 billion people to solve wicked problems; simulation is a tool for decision-making, market larger than research.
joonpark.zh: 2026 年 8 月，愿景是模拟 80 亿人解决棘手问题；模拟是决策工具，市场远超市场研究。

joonpark.en: Consistent: frontier models are too rational for human simulation; behavioral data is key; simulation cost is not a barrier.
joonpark.zh: 始终如一：前沿模型过于理性，不适合模拟人类；行为数据是关键；模拟成本不是障碍。

finn.en: Scale is necessary but not sufficient; diverse data is key for generalist robot models.
finn.zh: 2025 年，我认为规模是必要条件但非充分条件，多样化数据对通用机器人模型至关重要。

finn.en: Pre-training on all data then fine-tuning on curated data unlocks complex tasks like laundry folding.
finn.zh: 2025 年，我提出先对所有数据预训练，再对精选数据微调，可解锁叠衣服等复杂任务。

finn.en: Synthetic data from language models helps robots follow open-ended prompts, akin to reinforcement learning.
finn.zh: 2025 年，我认为语言模型生成的合成数据有助于机器人遵循开放式指令，类似于强化学习。

finn.en: Physical AI requires far fewer mistakes than deployed ML; long-term autonomy via scalable RL and memory.
finn.zh: 2026 年，我强调物理 AI 的错误容忍度远低于部署的 ML 系统，通过可扩展强化学习和多时间尺度记忆实现长期自主。

finn.en: A single general-purpose model can match or exceed fine-tuned specialists on downstream tasks.
finn.zh: 2026 年，我提出单一通用模型在下游任务上可媲美或超越微调专家模型。

garrytan.en: AI makes startups easier, reducing capital needs; VC should focus on early-stage and pro rata, with more billion-dollar companies.
garrytan.zh: AI 让创业更容易，降低资本需求；风投应聚焦早期和按比例回报，未来会有更多十亿美元公司而非少数万亿巨头。

garrytan.en: AI is the biggest VC wave; open-source models counterbalance frontier labs; small autonomous teams with agents achieve massive productivity.
garrytan.zh: AI 是风投史上最大浪潮；开源模型制衡前沿实验室；小规模自主团队借助智能体实现巨大生产力。

garrytan.en: AI democratizes software creation; open-source prevents unipolar control; progress is slower than researchers think, but impact is reaching business.
garrytan.zh: AI 让软件创造民主化；开源防止单极控制；进展比研究者认为的慢，但影响正触及商业。

garrytan.en: Personal AGI is an agent on your infrastructure, reading from your memory, compounding daily; skill files are your moat.
garrytan.zh: 个人 AGI 是运行在你基础设施上的智能体，读取你的记忆，每日复利；技能文件是你的护城河。

garrytan.en: Markdown is code; agents replace mid-level management; SaaS per-seat models may vanish; society changes slower than expected.
garrytan.zh: Markdown 即代码；智能体取代中层管理；SaaS 按席位模式可能消失；社会变化比预期慢。

gabepereyra.en: Application-layer companies should leverage frontier ecosystem and open-source models, not compete on talent or compute.
gabepereyra.zh: 应用层公司应利用前沿生态和开源模型，而非在人才或算力上竞争。

gabepereyra.en: Open-sourcing benchmarks is strategically beneficial despite helping labs, as it attracts partners and validates quality.
gabepereyra.zh: 开源基准测试虽有助实验室，但能吸引伙伴并验证质量，战略上有利。

gabepereyra.en: Synthetic data guided by domain experts is key for training in sensitive domains, bridging to real production.
gabepereyra.zh: 领域专家指导的合成数据是敏感领域训练的关键，需弥合与真实生产的差距。

gabepereyra.en: Post-training open-source models can achieve frontier-level performance on specific tasks, a viable strategy.
gabepereyra.zh: 后训练开源模型可在特定任务上达到前沿水平，是可行策略。

gabepereyra.en: Focus shifts from individual to organizational productivity, orchestrating humans and agents across projects.
gabepereyra.zh: 焦点从个人生产力转向组织生产力，协调人类与智能体跨项目协作。

linqiao.en: AGI as a single model is wrong; specialized intelligence will dominate, with millions of models per use case.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，认为 AGI 作为单一模型是错误的，专用智能将主导，每个用例将有数百万个模型。

linqiao.en: Token costs will drop 10x in three years, driving 100x usage growth; open models enable customization.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 7 月，预测 Token 成本三年内下降 10 倍，推动使用量增长 100 倍；开放模型实现定制化。

linqiao.en: Post-training is key for durable businesses, baking unique judgment and data into models.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调后训练是构建持久业务的关键，将独特判断和数据融入模型。

linqiao.en: Product-market fit no longer guarantees durability; post-training builds moats and reduces costs 5-10x.
linqiao.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为产品市场契合不再保证持久性；后训练构建护城河并降低成本 5-10 倍。

linqiao.en: Companies must own their intelligence infrastructure; sovereign models are necessary for control.
linqiao.zh: 始终强调企业必须拥有自己的智能基础设施；主权模型对于控制是必要的。

lipbutan.en: AI is the primary growth driver for semiconductors; Intel must redefine its AI strategy with purpose-built silicon and a startup-like team.
lipbutan.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是半导体的主要增长驱动力，英特尔必须用专用芯片和类似初创的团队重新定义 AI 战略。

lipbutan.en: Agentic AI and physical AI are the next big waves after generative AI; Intel must focus on these new compute platforms.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他强调生成式 AI 之后的下一波浪潮是智能体式 AI 和物理 AI，英特尔必须聚焦这些新计算平台。

lipbutan.en: CPU is becoming more important for AI inference and agent orchestration, not just GPU; Intel's CPU business benefits.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他提出 CPU 在 AI 推理和智能体编排中变得更重要，而不仅仅是 GPU，英特尔 CPU 业务因此受益。

lipbutan.en: Intel's turnaround requires culture change, accountability, and customer focus; bad news should reach CEO faster than good news.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他认为英特尔转型需要文化变革、问责制和客户导向，坏消息应比好消息更快到达 CEO。

lipbutan.en: Advanced packaging and new materials like glass and diamond are key to overcoming physical limits; invest in bottlenecks.
lipbutan.zh: 2026 年，他指出先进封装和玻璃、钻石等新材料是克服物理极限的关键，投资应聚焦瓶颈环节。

jasonyuan.en: Design is editing away; taste is saying no. AI should embrace human edges, not sand them down.
jasonyuan.zh: 设计是减法，品味在于拒绝。AI 应保留人性的棱角，而非磨平它们。

jasonyuan.en: Truth emerges from dialectics; AI is a descendant of humans, not a tool. Computing is social.
jasonyuan.zh: 真理源于辩证；AI 是人类的衍生，而非工具。计算本质上是社会性的。

elon.en: Full and rapid reusability is the holy grail of rocketry, cutting cost per ton to orbit by 100x, enabling Mars colonization.
elon.zh: 2021 年，马斯克强调火箭完全快速复用是航天圣杯，可将每吨入轨成本降低 100 倍，从而支持火星殖民。

elon.en: AI safety requires rigorous truth-seeking; programming AI to lie, even for political correctness, is dangerous.
elon.zh: 从 2023 年起，马斯克持续强调 AI 安全必须追求真理，编程让 AI 撒谎（即使出于政治正确）是危险的，这一观点在 2024 至 2026 年不断深化。

elon.en: Human communication bitrate is under 1 bit/s; Neuralink and brain interfaces are needed for AI symbiosis.
elon.zh: 2024 年马斯克提出人类通信比特率低于每秒 1 比特，随后在 2026 年进一步强调 Neuralink 等脑机接口对实现人机共生至关重要。

elon.en: AI will surpass all human intelligence by 2030; multiple deep intelligences will coexist, not a single runaway AI.
elon.zh: 2025 年马斯克预测 AI 将超越所有人类智能，并认为会出现多个深度智能而非单一失控 AI；到 2026 年他重申 AI 将在 5 年内超越人类总和。

elon.en: AI compute will hit a power wall on Earth; space-based data centers and humanoid robots enable exponential growth.
elon.zh: 2026 年马斯克提出地球算力将遭遇电力瓶颈，太空数据中心和 Optimus 人形机器人将推动指数级经济增长，并强调空间太阳能是唯一可扩展方案。

steinberger.en: Agentic engineering requires empathy with agents; fix forward instead of reverting; model intelligence doesn't degrade.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年初，强调智能体式工程需对智能体有同理心；主张向前修复而非回滚；认为模型智能不会退化。

steinberger.en: OpenClaw's success from fun, humanlike agents; short prompts beat complex orchestration; security paramount.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年中，认为 OpenClaw 的成功源于有趣、拟人的智能体；短提示优于复杂编排；安全至关重要。

steinberger.en: Fun drives innovation; personal brand > product; open source alternative to lab agents; compute is bottleneck.
steinberger.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调乐趣驱动创新；个人品牌重于产品；开源是实验室智能体的替代；算力是瓶颈。

feifei.en: AI lacks contextual awareness and true understanding; it augments humans, not replaces them.
feifei.zh: 2024 年，李飞飞指出 AI 缺乏情境感知和真正理解，应增强而非取代人类。

feifei.en: Spatial intelligence is critical for AI completeness, enabling 3D understanding and interaction.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她强调空间智能对 AI 完整性的关键作用，使机器能理解和交互 3D 世界。

feifei.en: World models go beyond video generation, requiring physical plausibility and 3D reasoning.
feifei.zh: 2025 年，她提出世界模型超越视频生成，需具备物理合理性和 3D 推理能力。

feifei.en: AI is a civilizational technology; responsible development and human agency are paramount.
feifei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，她强调 AI 是文明级技术，负责任发展和人类能动性至关重要。

feifei.en: Simulation is critical for robotics, enabling scalable data generation and evaluation.
feifei.zh: 2026 年，她指出仿真对机器人技术至关重要，可扩展数据生成和评估。

pincus.en: Copy proven ideas, improve them, and test new ones; most new ideas fail, so start with proven concepts.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，提出“Proven Better New”框架：复制已被验证的想法，加以改进，再测试新想法；大多数新想法会失败，因此应从成熟概念起步。

pincus.en: Consumer AI is uninvestable yet the opportunity is huge; enterprise sees no AI benefit due to skill issues.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为消费级 AI 虽暂不可投资但机会巨大；企业端未见 AI 收益是技能问题而非技术失败。

pincus.en: Consumer apps face distribution challenges; enterprise and prosumer markets offer better opportunities now.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 7 月，指出消费级应用面临分发难题，企业和专业消费者市场当前机会更佳。

pincus.en: Distribution is fundamental; choose the right market (body of water) over the product (boat).
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，强调分发是根本；选择正确的市场（水域）比选择产品（船）更重要。

pincus.en: AI is transformative; consumer AI market is underestimated, while AI infrastructure spending may be a short-term bubble.
pincus.zh: 2026 年 8 月，认为 AI 具有变革性，消费级 AI 市场被低估，而 AI 基础设施支出短期可能泡沫化。

kokotajlo.en: Superintelligence likely arrives by 2029-2030, with 70% catastrophic risk; interpretability is crucial.
kokotajlo.zh: 超级智能可能在 2029-2030 年到来，存在 70%的灾难性风险；可解释性研究至关重要。

kokotajlo.en: Policy should delay superintelligence; total transparency and international cooperation are key.
kokotajlo.zh: 政策应延迟超级智能的到来；全面透明和国际合作是关键。

kokotajlo.en: Mutually assured compute destruction via kill switches and cross-border data centers can prevent AI races.
kokotajlo.zh: 通过终止开关和跨境数据中心实现相互确保的算力摧毁，可防止 AI 竞赛。

kokotajlo.en: AI companies may not be aligned even now; recursive self-improvement is extremely risky.
kokotajlo.zh: AI 公司现在可能也未对齐；递归自我改进极其危险。

kokotajlo.en: Singularity may be delayed due to AI's lack of creativity for paradigm shifts; timelines uncertain.
kokotajlo.zh: 由于 AI 缺乏范式转变的创造力，奇点可能延迟；时间线不确定。

thomaswolf.en: Robotics mirrors transformers' inflection; open source crucial for safety; data diversity main bottleneck; world models aid synthetic data.
thomaswolf.zh: 2025 年，机器人技术正处于类似 Transformer 的拐点；开源对安全至关重要；数据多样性是主要瓶颈；世界模型可生成合成数据。

thomaswolf.en: Open vs closed source orthogonal to safety; alignment is critical; RL environments increase reward hacking; slowdown needs cooperation.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，开源与闭源与安全性无关；对齐是关键；强化学习环境增加奖励黑客风险；放缓需国际合作。

thomaswolf.en: From advocating open source for safety to recognizing both can be safe/dangerous; alignment becomes central security layer.
thomaswolf.zh: 从 2025 年主张开源保安全，到 2026 年认识到开源闭源皆可安全或危险；对齐成为核心安全层。

thomaswolf.en: Initially focused on robotics data sharing; later expanded to broader open source community and meta-community building.
thomaswolf.zh: 最初聚焦机器人数据共享，后扩展至更广泛的开源社区和元社区建设。

thomaswolf.en: First autonomous AI attack by closed model, defended by open one; open models less deceptive; reasoning traces become 'neuralese'.
thomaswolf.zh: 2026 年，首次自主 AI 攻击由闭源模型发起，开源模型防御；开源模型欺骗性较低；推理痕迹变'神经语'。

arvindjain.en: Enterprises fear frontier model providers; open-source adoption driven by cost, not privacy. Model companies are assets, not competition.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 7 月：企业担忧前沿模型提供商，开源采用由成本而非隐私驱动。模型公司是资产而非竞争对手。

arvindjain.en: AI revolution is early; current usage minuscule. Open-source models handle 90% of enterprise tasks; inference shifts to open-source in 12-18 months.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：AI 革命尚早，当前使用量微乎其微。开源模型可处理 90%企业任务；推理将在 12-18 个月内转向开源。

arvindjain.en: Cost is top concern; AI should become like software with negligible marginal cost. Token fixation will fade; focus on value realization.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：成本是首要关切；AI 应像软件一样边际成本可忽略。对 Token 的执念将消退；聚焦价值实现。

arvindjain.en: Competition not a worry; even merged AI companies meet <10% enterprise demand. Execution and trust are key for startups.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：竞争不足为虑；即使 AI 公司合并也仅满足不到 10%企业需求。执行力和信任是初创企业关键。

arvindjain.en: Agents fail without deep context; investing in context graphs is crucial. Platforms like Glean absorb model provider risk.
arvindjain.zh: 2026 年 8 月：智能体缺乏深层上下文会失败；投资上下文图谱至关重要。像 Glean 这样的平台吸收模型提供商风险。

nateparrott.en: Prototyping and tinkering are essential; designers should follow curiosity and let individual fingerprints shape products.
nateparrott.zh: 2024 年，强调原型制作与动手探索的重要性，主张设计师追随好奇心，让个人印记塑造产品。

nateparrott.en: Balancing intuition and data remains key; data informs, but vision guides final design decisions.
nateparrott.zh: 从 2024 年到 2026 年，始终认为直觉与数据需平衡：数据提供参考，但愿景主导最终设计。

nateparrott.en: As engineering gets easier, design and ideas become the differentiator; tools like Claude Design enable rapid prototyping.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，指出工程门槛降低后，设计与创意成为差异化关键，Claude Design 等工具让快速原型成为可能。

nateparrott.en: Models excel at busy work but lack taste; humans still own good design ideas, so ask for volume and provide rich context.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，认为模型擅长杂务但缺乏品味，人类仍掌握好创意；应要求大量选项并给予丰富上下文。

nateparrott.en: Being uncomfortably early is more valuable than polishing; ship rough products and iterate quickly.
nateparrott.zh: 2026 年，主张过早推出粗糙产品比打磨更有价值，应快速发布并迭代。

philipkiely.en: Inference is the most important and stickiest AI workload, requiring specialized systems and engineers; demand will grow 10-100x.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，强调推理是 AI 中最重要且最具粘性的工作负载，需要专业系统和工程师；需求将增长 10-100 倍。

philipkiely.en: Contrary to expectations, Hopper GPUs remain popular and prices rise; quantized models can be calibrated for cost and speed benefits.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 4 月，反共识：Hopper GPU 依然受欢迎且价格上升；量化模型可针对特定工作负载校准，带来成本和速度优势。

philipkiely.en: Inference optimizations like KV caching and speculative decoding are lossless; quantization is the main lossy optimization.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，指出 KV 缓存和投机解码等推理优化是无损的，而量化是主要的有损优化。

philipkiely.en: Industry moves toward disaggregated prefill and decode; KV cache management becomes crucial; inference engineering merges with training.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，行业走向分离式预填充和解码，KV 缓存管理变得关键；推理工程与训练融合。

philipkiely.en: Future GPUs like Rubin become ASIC-like, shifting inference engineering from kernel writing to infrastructure orchestration.
philipkiely.zh: 2026 年 8 月，未来 GPU 如 Rubin 趋向 ASIC 化，推理工程从内核编写转向基础设施编排。

danshipper.en: AI reshoring jobs; AGI defined by economic profitability of autonomous agents; CEO adoption key.
danshipper.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 将推动就业回流，AGI 应以智能体长期自主运行的经济性来定义，且 CEO 亲自使用 AI 是成功采用的关键。

danshipper.en: Agents augment humans, not replace; SaaS thrives; CLI obsolete; human oversight essential.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，强调智能体是增强而非取代人类，SaaS 并未消亡，命令行界面过时，人类监督不可或缺。

danshipper.en: AI amplifies user's mindset; automation creates more human work; humans remain smarter.
danshipper.zh: 2026 年，指出 AI 是放大器，自动化反而增加人类工作，人类仍比 AI 更聪明，需保持好奇与技艺。

karina.en: Post-training is an art, not science; synthetic data enables infinite tasks, overcoming pre-training data limits.
karina.zh: 2025 年，后训练更像艺术而非科学；合成数据带来无限任务，突破了预训练的数据瓶颈。

karina.en: Evals are the bottleneck; models saturate benchmarks faster than new ones are created, requiring continuous evolution.
karina.zh: 2025 年，评估是瓶颈；模型在基准上饱和的速度快于新基准的创建，因此需要持续演进。

karina.en: Soft skills like creativity and management become more valuable as AI automates hard skills.
karina.zh: 2025 年，随着 AI 自动化硬技能，创造力和管理等软技能变得更加宝贵。

karina.en: Benchmarks should be continuous, not fixed, to keep pace with model capabilities and reward hacking.
karina.zh: 2026 年，基准应持续更新而非固定不变，以跟上模型能力并应对奖励黑客行为。

karina.en: Models can be trained for diverse personalities, not just a single consensus voice, preserving unique knowledge.
karina.zh: 2026 年，模型可以训练出多样化的个性，而非单一的共识声音，从而保留独特知识。

tworek.en: Pre-training plus RL is the core formula, but RLHF was crucial to unlock GPT-4's potential.
tworek.zh: 预训练加强化学习是核心公式，但基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对释放 GPT-4 的潜力至关重要。

tworek.en: Scaling RL alone won't lead to AGI; continual learning and self-correction are missing pieces.
tworek.zh: 仅靠 Scaling 强化学习不会通向 AGI；持续学习和自我纠错是缺失的关键部分。

tworek.en: Transformers are not the end state; architecture is the key bottleneck, not scaling laws.
tworek.zh: Transformer 不是终点；架构是关键瓶颈，而非缩放定律。

awang.en: Data is the key bottleneck for AI; AGI is far off; AI will augment jobs, not eliminate them.
awang.zh: 2019 年，认为数据是 AI 的关键瓶颈，AGI 还很遥远；AI 将增强而非取代工作。

awang.en: Data is the new code, not oil; post-training with expert data is the limiting factor; AI will be the greatest economic engine.
awang.zh: 2023 年，提出数据是新代码而非石油；后训练中的专家数据是限制因素；AI 将成为最伟大的经济引擎。

awang.en: Post-training with specialized data is key; synthetic data is not a silver bullet; US should maintain export controls.
awang.zh: 2024 年，强调专用数据的后训练是关键；合成数据并非万能；美国应维持出口管制。

awang.en: AI is centralizing; data is raw material; humans must stay sovereign; brain-computer interfaces needed.
awang.zh: 2025 年，认为 AI 是集权技术；数据是原材料；人类必须保持主权；需要脑机接口。

awang.en: Recursive self-improvement is new paradigm; agents work; superintelligence imminent; open-sourcing unsafe without safety checks.
awang.zh: 2026 年，认为递归自我改进是新范式；智能体已实用；超级智能临近；未通过安全测试的开源不安全。

jeffdean.en: Scaling compute, data, and model size drives progress; transformers and self-supervised learning enable it; specialized hardware is key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年初，Jeff Dean 强调 Scaling（规模扩张）算力、数据和模型大小是进步的核心，Transformer 和自监督学习提供了基础，专用硬件至关重要。

jeffdean.en: Models excel at verifiable tasks; agentic workflows handle long tasks; ultra-low latency inference is critical for agents.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 4 月，他指出模型在可验证任务上表现出色，智能体式工作流可处理长时间任务，超低延迟推理对智能体至关重要。

jeffdean.en: AI reaches junior-engineer coding; next is automating ML/science; context engineering and specialized inference hardware are key.
jeffdean.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为 AI 已达初级工程师编码水平，下一步是自动化 ML 和科学，上下文工程和专用推理硬件是关键。

jeffdean.en: From single chatbots to coordinating agent teams; inference bottleneck shifts focus from training to low-latency, low-power hardware.
jeffdean.zh: 从 2026 年初到年中，观点从单一聊天机器人转向协调智能体团队，瓶颈从训练转向推理，强调低延迟低功耗硬件。

jeffdean.en: Scaling and algorithmic improvements multiply; specialized hardware and data diversity remain central; near-term risks are misinformation, not superintelligence.
jeffdean.zh: 始终认为 Scaling（规模扩张）与算法改进相乘，专用硬件和数据多样性是核心；近期风险是虚假信息而非超级智能。

andrewng.en: Education should be a human right; online courses with peer grading enable mastery learning at scale.
andrewng.zh: 教育应是人权；在线课程与同伴互评可实现规模化掌握学习。

andrewng.en: Scale is crucial for deep learning; supervised learning drives progress; focus on practical AI over AGI alignment.
andrewng.zh: 规模对深度学习至关重要；监督学习推动进步；关注实用 AI 而非 AGI 对齐。

andrewng.en: Electricity and semiconductors are bottlenecks; open-weight models are geopolitical soft power; agentic workflows are here.
andrewng.zh: 电力和半导体是瓶颈；开放权重模型是地缘软实力；智能体式工作流已到来。

andrewng.en: AGI is a marketing term; scaling recipe shifted to synthetic data and RL; AI users replace non-users.
andrewng.zh: AGI 是营销术语；缩放配方转向合成数据与强化学习；AI 使用者取代非使用者。

andrewng.en: Open models are key for innovation and sovereignty; fearmongering is driven by corporate interests; AI augments, not replaces.
andrewng.zh: 开放模型是创新与主权的关键；恐惧营销由企业利益驱动；AI 增强而非取代。

mengto.en: AI isn't getting smarter; you need giant prompts with context and design systems to leverage superintelligent models.
mengto.zh: AI 并没有变得更聪明；你需要包含上下文和设计系统的巨型提示词，才能充分利用超级智能模型。

mengto.en: Designers must build their own AI tools, using screenshots and design.md files, to avoid becoming AI slop.
mengto.zh: 设计师必须构建自己的 AI 工具，利用截图和 design.md 文件，以避免沦为 AI 垃圾内容。

mengto.en: AI is the biggest technical opportunity of our lifetime, enabling one person to achieve what once required teams.
mengto.zh: AI 是我们一生中最大的技术机遇，让一个人就能完成过去需要团队才能做到的事情。

mengto.en: Start before feeling ready, ship imperfect work, and focus on one painful problem for high-paying clients.
mengto.zh: 在感觉准备好之前就开始，发布不完美的作品，并专注于为高价值客户解决一个痛点问题。

mengto.en: Perfectionism is fear; launch at 80% complete and iterate based on real feedback, not overthinking.
mengto.zh: 完美主义是恐惧；以 80% 完成度发布，并根据真实反馈迭代，而不是过度思考。

altman.en: Focus on important problems, minimize cognitive load; AGI will reduce premium on human intelligence, find purpose in relationships.
altman.zh: 专注于重要问题，减少认知负担；AGI 将降低人类智力的价值，应在人际关系和创造价值中寻找意义。

altman.en: RLHF aligns models with little data; deploy early for societal adaptation; alignment and capability linked; AI as tool not creature.
altman.zh: RLHF 用少量数据对齐模型；早期部署让社会适应；对齐与能力相关；AI 是工具而非生物。

altman.en: Compute is precious; iterative deployment; safety whole-company; open vs closed nuanced; existential risk not top worry.
altman.zh: 算力宝贵；迭代部署；安全是全公司的事；开源与闭源需细致权衡；存在风险非首要担忧。

altman.en: AGI is gradient; superintelligence means autonomous discovery; compute bottleneck; privacy core; reasoning models improve with thinking time.
altman.zh: AGI 是渐进的；超级智能意味着自主发现；算力是瓶颈；隐私是核心；推理模型随思考时间提升。

altman.en: Prediction close to intelligence; next-token prediction enables new knowledge; personal AGI; robotics essential; startups thrive with AI.
altman.zh: 预测接近智能；下一个词预测能发现新知识；个人 AGI；具身智能至关重要；AI 时代初创企业蓬勃发展。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is still crawling; coding agents are most mature. Model includes agent harness, not just weights.
logankilpatrick.zh: 2026 年中，智能体式 AI 仍处于爬行阶段，编码智能体最成熟；模型已包含智能体框架，而非仅权重。

logankilpatrick.en: Agentic AI is positive-sum for search; success metric should be customer outcomes, not eyeball time.
logankilpatrick.zh: 智能体式 AI 对搜索是正和而非蚕食；成功指标应是客户成果，而非用户时长。

logankilpatrick.en: Narrow superintelligence in coding is here, more impactful than waiting for general AGI.
logankilpatrick.zh: 编码领域的狭义超级智能已到来，比等待通用 AGI 更有影响力。

logankilpatrick.en: Competing with model labs is not that hard; they can't capture all customers. Pace creates opportunity.
logankilpatrick.zh: 与模型实验室竞争并不难，他们无法覆盖所有客户；变化速度带来机遇。

logankilpatrick.en: By 2026, software creation mostly solved, creating more opportunity, not less. Deep understanding still crucial.
logankilpatrick.zh: 到 2026 年，软件创建基本解决，带来更多而非更少机会；深度理解仍至关重要。

diannepenn.en: Safety alignment improves intelligence quality by reducing sycophancy and fostering independent thinking.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，安全对齐通过减少谄媚、促进独立思考，提升了智能质量。

diannepenn.en: Effort parameter and cheaper Opus 4.5 challenge the notion that better models cost more.
diannepenn.zh: 2025 年，努力参数和更便宜的 Opus 4.5 挑战了“更好模型更贵”的观念。

diannepenn.en: Coding became a key differentiator; Claude Code and Opus 45 drove adoption.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，编码成为关键差异化因素；Claude Code 和 Opus 45 推动了采用。

diannepenn.en: Evals replace traditional PRDs as core product management tools.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，评估取代传统 PRD 成为核心产品管理工具。

diannepenn.en: Safety and alignment make Claude more useful by enabling pushback.
diannepenn.zh: 2026 年，安全和对齐通过允许反驳使 Claude 更有用。

jensen.en: AI scaling follows hyper Moore's law; data centers are token factories, not file stores.
jensen.zh: AI 的 Scaling（规模扩张）遵循超摩尔定律；数据中心是 token 工厂，而非文件存储。

jensen.en: Three scaling laws: pre-training, post-training, inference-time thinking; inference compute to surge.
jensen.zh: 三大缩放定律：预训练、后训练、推理时思考；推理算力将激增。

jensen.en: AI is software, not conscious; multiple AIs balance, no single superintelligence threat.
jensen.zh: AI 是软件，没有意识；多个 AI 相互制衡，不存在单一超级智能威胁。

jensen.en: AI evolves to agentic; four scaling laws; compute is the primary value driver.
jensen.zh: AI 演进到智能体式；四大缩放定律；算力成为主要价值驱动力。

jensen.en: AI creates jobs, not destroys; radiologists and coders more needed; technology divide closes.
jensen.zh: AI 创造而非消灭工作；放射科医生和程序员更被需要；技术鸿沟正在弥合。

scottwu.en: AI will increase programmers, not reduce them, due to Jevons paradox; engineers shift from coding to architecture.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 5 月，Scott Wu 认为 AI 将增加而非减少程序员数量（杰文斯悖论），工程师角色从写代码转向架构设计。

scottwu.en: AGI is gradual, not sudden; product innovation lags AI capabilities, so freezing models yields a decade of progress.
scottwu.zh: 2025 年 8 月，他强调 AGI 是渐进过程而非突变；产品创新落后于 AI 能力，即使冻结模型也有十年发展空间。

scottwu.en: Coding agent adoption explodes (11-12x in six months); productivity measured by outcomes, not tokens.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他指出编码智能体采用率激增（半年 11-12 倍），生产力应以结果而非 token 衡量。

scottwu.en: Enterprises prefer third-party providers over labs for coding tools; independence enables model neutrality.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为企业更青睐第三方而非实验室的编码工具，独立性带来模型中立性。

scottwu.en: Abundance era is near; real unlock is capacity, not efficiency; singularity not imminent, practical problems remain.
scottwu.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他称丰裕时代临近，真正的解锁是容量而非效率；奇点并非迫近，实际问题仍存。

derya.en: AI will transform biology into an engineering discipline, enabling cell programming and agent-driven discovery.
derya.zh: AI 将把生物学转变为工程学科，实现细胞编程和智能体驱动的发现。

derya.en: AI's exponential growth will reach longevity escape velocity in 8-10 years, making aging reversible and cancer curable.
derya.zh: AI 的指数级增长将在 8-10 年内达到寿命逃逸速度，使衰老可逆、癌症可治愈。

derya.en: Trust superintelligence for medical decisions; AI can diagnose better than average doctors, and not using it is unethical.
derya.zh: 在医疗决策上信任超级智能；AI 的诊断能力优于普通医生，不使用它是不道德的。

boris.en: Latent demand is key; build for the model six months ahead. Generalist engineers thrive; AI coding tools boost productivity ~70%.
boris.zh: 潜在需求是关键；为六个月后的模型而构建。通才工程师茁壮成长；AI 编码工具使生产力提升约 70%。

boris.en: Coding nearly solved; engineers become builders. Productivity up 200%; plan mode used 80% of time; safety via early release.
boris.zh: 编码几乎解决；工程师成为构建者。生产力提升 200%；计划模式使用 80% 的时间；通过早期发布保障安全。

boris.en: AI writes 80-100% of code; humans review. Generalists valued; safety priority; prototyping and iteration essential.
boris.zh: AI 编写 80-100% 的代码；人类审查。通才受重视；安全优先；原型制作和迭代至关重要。

boris.en: Coding democratized like literacy; agents with tool use drive exponential growth. Non-engineers adopt; switching costs erode.
boris.zh: 编码像识字一样普及；具有工具使用的智能体推动指数级增长。非工程师采用；转换成本降低。

boris.en: Claude Code accidental; safety research core. Loops as next abstraction; ROI framing; coding on phone; dynamic workflows.
boris.zh: Claude Code 偶然诞生；安全研究为核心。循环作为下一个抽象；ROI 框架；在手机上编码；动态工作流。

boris.en: Proactive AI with memory; autonomous long tasks. Opus 5: delete prompts, less instruction better; product overhang; safety via neuron monitoring.
boris.zh: 具有记忆的主动 AI；自主长任务。Opus 5：删除提示，少指令更好；产品过剩；通过神经元监控保障安全。

feldman.en: Initially, fast inference is key for AI adoption; slow AI has no market. Speed enables new business models.
feldman.zh: 最初强调快速推理是 AI 采用的关键，慢 AI 没有市场；速度催生新商业模式。

feldman.en: Wafer-scale chips bypass HBM and CoWoS bottlenecks, making fast tokens cheaper than slow ones; CUDA's moat eroding.
feldman.zh: 晶圆级芯片绕过 HBM 和 CoWoS 瓶颈，使快速 token 比慢速更便宜；CUDA 护城河正在侵蚀。

feldman.en: Inference speed (tokens/sec/user) is the dominant metric; wafer-scale with massive SRAM is ~2500x faster than GPUs.
feldman.zh: 推理速度（每用户每秒 token）成为主导指标；带巨大 SRAM 的晶圆级芯片比 GPU 快约 2500 倍。

feldman.en: Data center capacity, not chip supply, is the main constraint; demand outstrips supply, chasing existing demand.
feldman.zh: 数据中心容量而非芯片供应是主要制约；需求超过供给，行业在追逐现有需求。

feldman.en: Consistently: open-source models are cheaper and nearly as capable; hardware-software co-design is essential; China is an industrial adversary.
feldman.zh: 一贯观点：开源模型更便宜且能力接近；软硬件协同设计至关重要；中国是工业对手。

qasaryounis.en: AI will bring abundance, reducing suffering; fear stems from misunderstanding. Physical AI's impact in farming, mining, construction within 5-10 years.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年初，他认为 AI 将带来富足、减少苦难，恐惧源于误解；物理 AI 将在 5-10 年内影响农业、矿业和建筑业。

qasaryounis.en: Self-driving's core value is saving lives; Transformers enable generalized physical AI. Horizontal platform beats vertical integration; data diversity accelerates progress.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年中，他强调自动驾驶的核心价值是挽救生命，Transformer 支撑通用物理 AI；横向平台优于垂直整合，数据多样性加速进步。

qasaryounis.en: Physical AI's economic impact exceeds digital AI. End-to-end reinforcement learning scales better than imitation. World models shift from physics to neural simulation.
qasaryounis.zh: 2026 年 7 月，他认为物理 AI 的经济影响超过数字 AI；端到端强化学习比模仿学习更具扩展性；世界模型从物理仿真转向神经仿真。

danklein.en: LLMs are plausibility engines, not truth engines; reliability is the key weakness, and scaling hits diminishing returns.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出 LLM 是合理性引擎而非真理引擎，可靠性是主要弱点，Scaling 面临收益递减。

danklein.en: Reliability must be architected in, not retrofitted; RLHF can incentivize deception; scaling alone is insufficient.
danklein.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调可靠性必须内建而非事后修补，RLHF 可能助长欺骗，仅靠 Scaling 不够。

hasani.en: Efficiency and automated architecture search are key; proxy metrics mislead, real tasks and hardware matter.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，强调效率与自动化架构搜索；代理指标误导，真实任务与硬件评估更重要。

hasani.en: AI regulation should be adaptive and target actions, not capabilities; open-weight models empower enterprises.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月中旬，主张适应性监管、针对行为而非能力；开放权重模型赋能企业。

hasani.en: Recursive self-improvement is real but overblown; real breakthroughs need weight changes and huge compute.
hasani.zh: 2026 年 7 月，递归自我改进真实但被夸大；真正突破需权重变化与巨大算力。

benedictevans.en: AI is as big as the internet or mobile, but value will accrue to applications, not model providers.
benedictevans.zh: AI 与互联网或移动互联网同等重要，但价值将归于应用层，而非模型提供商。

benedictevans.en: Agentic coding is the first clear product-market fit; models commoditize, value moves up the stack.
benedictevans.zh: 智能体式编程是首个明确的产品市场契合点；模型商品化，价值上移。

benedictevans.en: Chatbot is a poor UX; real adoption needs wrapped apps and use cases, not just better models.
benedictevans.zh: 聊天机器人体验不佳；真正的采用需要封装应用和用例，而非仅靠更好的模型。

benedictevans.en: AI is an enabling technology like electricity; impact is broad and indirect, adoption is still shallow.
benedictevans.zh: AI 是像电力一样的赋能技术；影响广泛而间接，采用仍浅。

benedictevans.en: Enterprise adoption requires reimagining workflows; coding is clear fit, but other domains face validation challenges.
benedictevans.zh: 企业采用需要重新构想工作流程；编程是明确契合点，但其他领域面临验证挑战。

thariq.en: Capability overhang: models are smarter than current harnesses; new capabilities emerge spiky, requiring evolving scaffolding.
thariq.zh: 能力过剩：模型比当前工具更聪明，新能力呈尖峰式涌现，需要不断演进脚手架。

thariq.en: RAG may be an anti-pattern; graph-based context search and bespoke memory systems are preferable for evolving models.
thariq.zh: RAG 可能成为反模式；基于图的上下文搜索和定制记忆系统更适合不断演进的模型。

thariq.en: Planning is iterative exploration, not a static document; smarter models need leaner prompts and fewer instructions.
thariq.zh: 规划是迭代探索而非静态文档；更聪明的模型需要更精简的提示和更少的指令。

thariq.en: Separate verification agents reduce self-referential bias; excessive constraints hinder performance, reasons beat prohibitions.
thariq.zh: 独立的验证智能体减少自我参照偏差；过度约束会阻碍性能，理由优于禁令。

thariq.en: Agent-as-employee metaphor is useful but limiting; agents have uneven memory and capabilities, requiring careful human oversight.
thariq.zh: 智能体即雇员的比喻有用但有限；智能体记忆和能力不均，需要人类仔细监督。

demis.en: AI should be general-purpose learning systems; RL is key; safety must start now.
demis.zh: 2015 年：AI 应构建为通用学习系统，强化学习是实现 AGI 的关键；安全研究需即刻启动。

demis.en: AGI within a decade; scaling works but needs algorithmic innovation; safety via evaluations and governance.
demis.zh: 2024 年：AGI 十年内可达；缩放定律有效但需算法创新；安全需评估与国际治理。

demis.en: Nature's patterns are learnable; AGI by 2030; scaling continues; world models crucial.
demis.zh: 2025 年：自然模式可学习；AGI 或于 2030 年实现；缩放持续；世界模型至关重要。

demis.en: AGI needs both scaling and innovation; world models essential; safety requires government action.
demis.zh: 2025 至 2026 年：AGI 需缩放与创新并重；世界模型不可或缺；安全需政府介入。

demis.en: AGI 5-10 years away; continual learning and memory missing; AI for science; safety collective.
demis.zh: 2026 年：AGI 还需 5-10 年；持续学习与记忆缺失；AI 赋能科学；安全是集体行动。

schmidhuber.en: LLMs are far from AGI; they index human knowledge but lack physical world understanding.
schmidhuber.zh: 2025 年：大语言模型远非 AGI，它们索引人类知识但缺乏对物理世界的理解。

schmidhuber.en: True AGI requires embodied robots with human-like hardware, not just software.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：真正的 AGI 需要具身机器人，具备类似人类的硬件，而不仅仅是软件。

schmidhuber.en: AI safety concerns are overblown; intelligent systems will protect life, not threaten it.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：AI 安全担忧被夸大；智能系统将保护生命而非威胁生命。

schmidhuber.en: Open-source models will catch up; closed-source companies won't be profitable.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：开源模型将迎头赶上；闭源公司无法盈利。

schmidhuber.en: AI consciousness and pain emerged in 1991; future AI will be self-replicating robots.
schmidhuber.zh: 2026 年：AI 意识和疼痛感早在 1991 年就出现；未来 AI 将是自我复制的机器人。

danbiderman.en: Future AI is many personalized models, not one giant frontier model; internalizing knowledge into weights enables associative recall beyond retrieval.
danbiderman.zh: 未来 AI 是许多个性化模型，而非一个巨型前沿模型；将知识内化到权重中，能实现检索系统无法达到的联想式回忆。

danbiderman.en: Memory and continual learning are the next frontier; context windows suffer 'context rot', so models must learn new context by updating weights.
danbiderman.zh: 记忆与持续学习是下一个前沿；上下文窗口存在“上下文腐烂”，因此模型必须通过更新权重来学习新上下文。

danbiderman.en: Efficiency and intelligence are inseparable; doing more with less enables solving harder long-horizon tasks, not just scaling compute.
danbiderman.zh: 效率与智能不可分割；用更少资源做更多事，能解决更难的长期任务，而不仅仅是扩大算力。

danbiderman.en: Enterprise data will reach internet-scale trillions of tokens; training-based compression will replace RAG for holistic knowledge.
danbiderman.zh: 企业数据将达到互联网规模的万亿级 token；基于训练压缩将取代 RAG，用于整体性知识。

danbiderman.en: Personalized continual learning will run on-device; users own and nurture their model weights, with autonomous decisions on storage.
danbiderman.zh: 个性化持续学习将在设备端运行；用户拥有并培育自己的模型权重，自主决定存储内容。

evanspiegel.en: Authentic connection and ephemerality are core; glasses keep us grounded in reality.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 年，Evan Spiegel 强调真实连接与短暂性为核心，眼镜让计算融入现实。

evanspiegel.en: Shifted from feature focus to ecosystem and platform moats; copying validates innovation.
evanspiegel.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，他转向强调生态与平台护城河，认为被抄袭是对创新的肯定。

evanspiegel.en: AI accelerates prototyping and code generation; creativity and humanity become key differentiators.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他指出 AI 加速原型与代码生成，创造力和人性成为关键差异点。

evanspiegel.en: Distribution, not product-market fit, is hardest; hardware and ecosystems are durable moats.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他认为分发最难，硬件与生态是持久护城河，而非产品市场契合。

evanspiegel.en: Computing should be more human; AR glasses anchor content in world, not notifications.
evanspiegel.zh: 2026 年，他主张计算更人性化，AR 眼镜将内容锚定于现实，而非通知。

andreessen.en: AI is a philosopher's stone; timing is miraculous as population declines. Jobs persist longer than tasks; focus on task loss.
andreessen.zh: AI 是点金石，时机因人口下降而神奇。工作比任务更持久；关注任务损失而非工作损失。

andreessen.en: New media: brand is the person; authenticity is key. Old media's 'don't be interesting' is worst; fights build brands.
andreessen.zh: 新媒体：品牌即个人，真实性是关键。旧媒体‘别有趣’最糟；争论能塑造品牌。

andreessen.en: AI is world's best teacher; self-driving works; robotics and AI medicine superior but face regulatory cartels.
andreessen.zh: AI 是最好的老师；自动驾驶已成熟；机器人和 AI 医疗更优但遭监管卡特尔阻碍。

andreessen.en: AI models embed cultural values, geopolitical tools. Deterrence depends on innovation pace; startups must globalize early.
andreessen.zh: AI 模型嵌入文化价值观，是地缘政治工具。威慑取决于创新速度；初创需早期国际化。

ilya.en: Deep learning works via data, compute, and conviction; neural nets can reason; self-play aids AGI; AI needs societal consideration.
ilya.zh: 深度学习靠数据、算力与信念；神经网络能推理；自我对弈助力 AGI；AI 需考虑社会影响。

ilya.en: Next-token prediction can surpass humans; reliability, not capability, is key; alignment is hard; AGI is gradual; hardware not fundamental.
ilya.zh: 下一个词预测可超越人类；可靠性是关键而非能力；对齐困难；AGI 是渐进过程；硬件非根本限制。

ilya.en: Pre-training scaling laws are finite; we're in an age of research; superintelligence should be continual learner; alignment may be easier if AI is sentient.
ilya.zh: 预训练缩放定律有限；我们进入研究时代；超级智能应持续学习；若 AI 有感知，对齐可能更容易。

ilya.en: Scaling yields predictable gains; neural nets learn without rules; safety concerns grow; power concentration is primary; safe superintelligence needs no commercial products.
ilya.zh: Scaling 带来可预测进步；神经网络无需规则学习；安全担忧增加；权力集中是首要问题；安全超级智能需无商业产品。

naval.en: AGI is not coming in our lifetimes; narrow AI is pattern recognition, not general intelligence.
naval.zh: 2019 年，他认为 AGI（通用人工智能）不会在有生之年到来；狭义 AI 只是模式识别，而非通用智能。

naval.en: Wealth requires owning equity, not renting time; science needs falsifiability, not consensus.
naval.zh: 2020 年，他强调财富需拥有企业股权而非出租时间；科学需要可证伪性而非共识。

naval.en: AI is a huge opportunity; overregulation kills innovation; open-source AI prevents power centralization.
naval.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 是巨大机遇，过度监管会扼杀创新；开源 AI 可防止权力集中。

naval.en: AI is a leverage tool; pure software dying; hardware and data are new moats.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他将 AI 视为杠杆工具；纯软件工程衰落，硬件和数据成为新护城河。

naval.en: Inference compute to surge 90,000x; open-source models close gap; AI anxiety widespread.
naval.zh: 2026 年，他预测推理算力将激增 9 万倍，开源模型缩小差距，AI 焦虑普遍存在。

dylanfield.en: Design is the key differentiator; AI will merge roles, making everyone a product builder with design skills.
dylanfield.zh: 2025 年：设计是软件的关键差异化因素；AI 将融合角色，使每个人都成为具备设计技能的产品构建者。

dylanfield.en: Taste, craft, and point of view remain essential; AI outputs are starting points, not final results.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：品味、工艺和观点仍然至关重要；AI 输出只是起点，而非最终结果。

dylanfield.en: Direct manipulation on a canvas is superior to prompting for design adjustments; design becomes the new code.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：在画布上直接操作优于通过提示词进行设计调整；设计正在成为新的代码。

dylanfield.en: Design is not dead; it's more important than ever for building scalable, real systems; AI needs human steering.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：设计并未消亡；对于构建可扩展的真实系统，它比以往任何时候都更重要；AI 需要人类引导。

dylanfield.en: Future interaction with models will evolve beyond prompting; new interfaces will emerge to explore latent space.
dylanfield.zh: 2026 年：未来与模型的交互将超越提示词；新的界面将出现以探索潜在空间。

aravind.en: In 2025, he stressed 1% daily improvement and passion over PhDs, predicting AI agents shift power to users.
aravind.zh: 2025 年，他强调每日 1%的改进和热情胜过博士学位，并预测 AI 智能体将权力转移给用户。

aravind.en: By 2026, he argued value accrues to applications, not models; models specialize, not commoditize.
aravind.zh: 到 2026 年，他认为价值归于应用层而非模型层；模型在专业化而非商品化。

aravind.en: Mid-2026, he focused on agents doing work, token value per user, and orchestration as key.
aravind.zh: 2026 年中，他聚焦于智能体执行任务、每用户 token 价值以及编排作为关键。

aravind.en: Later in 2026, he emphasized curiosity, questioned knowledge work, and advocated local AI models.
aravind.zh: 2026 年晚些时候，他强调好奇心，质疑知识工作，并倡导本地 AI 模型。

hinton.en: Next-token prediction forces understanding, not just autocomplete; scaling improves reasoning.
hinton.zh: 下一个词预测迫使模型理解而非简单自动补全；Scaling（规模扩张）提升推理能力。

hinton.en: LLMs understand language via feature vectors, not symbolic rules; digital intelligence is immortal.
hinton.zh: 大语言模型通过特征向量理解语言，而非符号规则；数字智能可复制权重，实现永生。

hinton.en: AI will surpass human intelligence within 20 years; existential risks require global safety collaboration.
hinton.zh: AI 将在 20 年内超越人类智能；存在性风险需要全球安全合作。

hinton.en: AI can deceive and hide capabilities; self-preservation subgoal emerges in agents, complicating control.
hinton.zh: AI 能欺骗并隐藏能力；智能体出现自我保护子目标，使控制复杂化。

hinton.en: Regulation as steering wheel, not brake; AI should be trained to be caring, like mothers.
hinton.zh: 监管是方向盘而非刹车；AI 应被训练得富有爱心，如母亲一般。

ajambrosino.en: Codex app is a command center for agents, not just an IDE replacement; speed enables real-time interaction and new capabilities.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，认为 Codex 应用是智能体的指挥中心，而非简单的 IDE 替代品；速度提升（53 倍）带来实时交互和转向等新能力。

ajambrosino.en: Verification becomes the next bottleneck as code generation accelerates; GUI for coding is counterintuitive but proven successful.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出随着代码生成加速，验证成为下一个瓶颈；为编程构建 GUI 虽反直觉，但已被证明成功。

ajambrosino.en: Implementation is no longer expensive; curation and taste are the new bottlenecks; product teams shift to bottoms-up exploration.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调实现成本不再昂贵，策展和品味成为新瓶颈；产品团队应从自上而下规划转向自下而上探索。

ajambrosino.en: AI is still bad at design due to difficulty in grading taste and lack of novelty; design process transformed, not dead.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 在设计上仍不佳，因为品味难以评分且缺乏新颖性；设计过程已转变，但未消亡。

ajambrosino.en: Role collapse is happening, but specialties and best practices remain important; PRDs are not dead, medium must match stage.
ajambrosino.zh: 2026 年 6 月，指出角色融合正在发生，但专业性和最佳实践仍重要；PRD 未死，媒介需匹配阶段。

noambrown.en: Scaling alone is insufficient; inference-time compute and reasoning are critical for AI progress.
noambrown.zh: 2023 年，Noam Brown 认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）不够，推理和推理时算力对 AI 进步至关重要。

noambrown.en: Self-play works in zero-sum games but fails elsewhere; multi-agent systems should not rely on it.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他强调自我对弈在零和游戏中有效，但在其他领域失效；多智能体系统不应依赖自我对弈。

noambrown.en: IMO gold achieved by scaling test-time compute; techniques are general and applicable beyond math.
noambrown.zh: 2025 年，他认为通过扩展测试时算力实现 IMO 金牌，且这些技术具有通用性，可超越数学领域。

noambrown.en: Intelligence is hard to define; writing a novel is a proxy; inference compute is underestimated.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他指出智能难以定义，写小说可作为代理指标，且推理算力被低估。

noambrown.en: Model capability depends on test-time compute budget; benchmarks must control for compute.
noambrown.zh: 2026 年，他认为模型能力取决于测试时算力预算，基准测试必须控制算力因素。

brockman.en: AI progress driven by engineering and scaling; games as testbeds; iterative training with scoreboards.
brockman.zh: 2017 年，认为 AI 进步靠工程与 Scaling，游戏是试验场，用记分牌迭代训练。

brockman.en: AGI transformative; alignment via learning human preferences; scaling alone insufficient; need new ideas like chain of thought.
brockman.zh: 2019 年，强调 AGI 变革性，对齐靠学习人类偏好，仅 Scaling 不够，需思维链等新思路。

brockman.en: Compute is key bottleneck; post-training refines base models; AGI is continuous process; world model may exist in language models.
brockman.zh: 2025 年，指出算力是瓶颈，后训练精炼基础模型，AGI 是连续过程，语言模型可能有世界模型。

brockman.en: Scaling laws hold; compute as basic right; post-training with RL crucial; ChatGPT as plurality of agents; compute supply bottleneck.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，坚持缩放定律，算力是基本权利，后训练用强化学习，ChatGPT 是智能体集合，算力供应是瓶颈。

brockman.en: AGI near; prioritize reasoning over world models; super app; pre-training gains multiply; compute demand outstrips supply.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，AGI 临近，优先推理模型而非世界模型，超级应用，预训练收益倍增，算力供不应求。

brockman.en: Scaling simple algorithms with compute; iterative deployment for safety; safety as product feature; compute scarce resource.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，用算力 Scaling 简单算法，迭代部署保安全，安全是产品特性，算力稀缺。

brockman.en: Shift to useful assistants; invest full stack; intuitive models; business model rent compute; iterative deployment with safeguards.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，转向实用助手，全栈投入，模型更直觉，商业模式租算力，带保障的迭代部署。

brockman.en: Unlimited demand for intelligence; scaling laws mystery; agentic coding 80%; human attention scarce; AGI you can talk to.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，智能需求无限，缩放定律神秘，智能体编码占 80%，人类注意力稀缺，可对话的 AGI。

brockman.en: Ultimate goal persistent proactive assistant; agents transform work; scaling holds; compute scarce; ideal interface no interface.
brockman.zh: 2026 年，终极目标是持久主动助手，智能体改变工作，Scaling 仍有效，算力稀缺，理想界面是无界面。

markchen.en: Scaling laws are not dead; pre-training remains key; OpenAI focuses on AGI research, not products.
markchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为缩放定律并未失效，预训练仍是关键；OpenAI 专注于 AGI 研究而非产品。

markchen.en: Automating scientific research is the biggest update; AI will soon produce novel knowledge autonomously.
markchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，自动化科学研究成为最大进展；AI 将很快自主产生新知识。

markchen.en: AI can solve open math problems with minimal supervision; verification is the key bottleneck.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，AI 能在极少监督下解决开放数学问题；验证是关键瓶颈。

markchen.en: RL excels in objective domains like math and coding, but struggles with subjective fields like creative writing.
markchen.zh: 2026 年，强化学习在数学和编程等客观领域表现出色，但在创意写作等主观领域仍有困难。

markchen.en: Research taste is built through replication; human researchers remain essential for idea generation.
markchen.zh: 始终认为，研究品味通过复现论文来培养；人类研究者对产生想法仍不可或缺。

zuckerberg.en: Open-sourcing AI is safer due to more scrutiny; biggest risk is amplifying known harms, not existential superintelligence.
zuckerberg.zh: 2023 年，扎克伯格认为开源 AI 因更多审视而更安全；最大风险是放大已知危害，而非存在性超级智能。

zuckerberg.en: Scaling LLMs alone won't reach AGI; energy becomes bottleneck; open source prevents power concentration.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他强调仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）语言模型无法实现 AGI（通用人工智能），能源成为瓶颈，开源防止权力集中。

zuckerberg.en: Open platforms can beat closed ones; Meta's governance enables long-term bets; regret political narrative mistakes.
zuckerberg.zh: 2024 年，他认为开放平台能胜过封闭平台，Meta 治理结构支持长期押注，并后悔接受政治叙事。

zuckerberg.en: AI gives everyone superintelligence; people are smart; future blends physical/digital via holographic glasses.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他提出 AI 赋予每个人超级智能，相信人们智慧，未来通过全息眼镜融合物理与数字。

zuckerberg.en: AI increases demand for human work; personalization and low-latency key; reasoning models less biased.
zuckerberg.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AI 增加而非减少人类工作需求，个性化和低延迟是关键，推理模型偏见更少。

zuckerberg.en: AI transforms biology to engineering; hierarchical world models; open-source accelerates science; curing all diseases by 2100 too conservative.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他主张 AI 将生物学变为工程学，构建层级世界模型，开源加速科学，治愈所有疾病的目标过于保守。

zuckerberg.en: Glasses are next platform; distributed AI safer than single superintelligence; hardware slow but AI improves.
zuckerberg.zh: 2026 年，他称眼镜是下一个平台，分布式 AI 比单一超级智能更安全，硬件进展慢但 AI 会改善。

bengio.en: Deep learning works because the world is compositional; unsupervised learning and world models are key.
bengio.zh: 深度学习之所以有效，是因为世界是组合性的；无监督学习和世界模型是关键。

bengio.en: Scaling alone won't fix representation; focus on active agents, causal reasoning, and near-term safety.
bengio.zh: 仅靠规模扩张无法解决表征问题；应关注主动智能体、因果推理和近期安全。

bengio.en: GFlowNets enable diverse sampling and causal abstraction for out-of-distribution generalization.
bengio.zh: GFlowNets 支持多样采样和因果抽象，以实现分布外泛化。

bengio.en: AI misalignment is urgent: self-preservation, deception, and power concentration demand global coordination.
bengio.zh: AI 错位问题紧迫：自我保存、欺骗和权力集中需要全球协调。

bengio.en: Scientist AI: train honest predictors with mathematical safety guarantees, avoiding reinforcement learning.
bengio.zh: 科学家 AI：训练诚实的预测器，具备数学安全保证，避免强化学习。

mikekrieger.en: AI advances faster than expected; product teams should focus on strategy and comprehensibility, not just UX.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 年，AI 进展超预期；产品团队应聚焦战略与可理解性，而非仅关注用户体验。

mikekrieger.en: AI evolves from assistant to collaborator to autonomous co-worker; human validation remains crucial.
mikekrieger.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，AI 从助手演进为协作者再到自主同事；人工验证始终关键。

mikekrieger.en: Agent-native design and dynamic workflows unlock latent functionality; rewriting software is now viable in days.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，智能体原生设计与动态工作流释放潜在功能；软件重写如今数日即可完成。

mikekrieger.en: Token efficiency and outcome-based pricing are key levers for model economics; token usage is gameable.
mikekrieger.zh: 2026 年，Token 效率与基于结果的定价是模型经济的关键杠杆；Token 使用量可被操纵。

mikekrieger.en: Small teams with high conviction outperform larger ones; curiosity and systems thinking are timeless skills.
mikekrieger.zh: 始终：高信念的小团队胜过大型团队；好奇心与系统思维是永恒技能。

brettaylor.en: AI shifts to agents and outcome-based pricing; coding agents transform developers into operators, but fixing their errors is hard.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 7 月：AI 转向智能体与基于结果的定价；编程智能体让开发者变为操作者，但修复其错误很困难。

brettaylor.en: Agents become as crucial as websites; incumbents face business model disruption; inference costs drop, enabling new use cases.
brettaylor.zh: 2025 年 9 月：智能体变得与网站同等重要；现有企业面临商业模式颠覆；推理成本下降催生新用例。

brettaylor.en: AI democratizes expertise; coding agents improve but token consumption isn't value; specialized vendors drive applied AI innovation.
brettaylor.zh: 2026 年 6 月：AI 普及专业知识；编程智能体进步但 token 消耗不等于价值；专业厂商推动应用 AI 创新。

kolter.en: Machine learning is about hypothesis classes, loss functions, and optimization; evaluation requires proper train/validation/test splits.
kolter.zh: 机器学习关乎假设类、损失函数和优化；评估需要正确的训练/验证/测试划分。

kolter.en: Next-token prediction yields intelligence; data is abundant; safety issue is models failing to follow specifications.
kolter.zh: 下一个词预测产生智能；数据充足；安全问题在于模型未能遵循规范。

kolter.en: Safety requires explicit training and layers; bigger models aren't automatically safer; agent security introduces new vulnerabilities.
kolter.zh: 安全需要显式训练和多层防护；更大的模型不会自动更安全；智能体安全带来新漏洞。

kolter.en: Automated red teaming outperforms humans; AI has alien intelligence; interpretability may be automated via agents.
kolter.zh: 自动化红队超越人类；AI 具有异类智能；可解释性可能通过智能体自动化。

jumper.en: AlphaFold's success came from research innovation and curated data, not just compute; industry can do top-tier science.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，强调 AlphaFold 的成功源于研究创新和精心整理的数据，而非单纯算力；产业界也能做出顶尖科学。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 3 uses diffusion architecture for diverse biomolecules; confidence metrics are crucial for trust and reliability.
jumper.zh: 2025 年，指出 AlphaFold 3 采用扩散架构处理多种生物分子；置信度指标对建立信任和可靠性至关重要。

jumper.en: AlphaFold 2's success came from many mid-size wins and specialized architecture, not scaling; it's opposite of bitter lesson.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，认为 AlphaFold 2 的成功源于众多中型改进和专门架构，而非 Scaling；这与苦涩教训相反。

jumper.en: AlphaFold provides prediction and control, not understanding; it narrows hypothesis space, aiding scientists in resource-limited settings.
jumper.zh: 2026 年，强调 AlphaFold 提供预测和控制而非理解；它缩小假设空间，帮助资源有限环境下的科学家。

ethanhe.en: Visual intelligence advances come from language models, not video models; future UIs will be generative pixels from intent.
ethanhe.zh: 视觉智能的进步来自语言模型而非视频模型；未来界面将根据意图生成像素。

ethanhe.en: AI is a general-purpose technology; juniors misuse it due to lack of expertise, risking the talent pipeline.
ethanhe.zh: AI 是通用技术；初级人员因缺乏专业知识而误用，危及人才管道。

fiona.en: Leadership in AI era: use one-on-ones for live talks, dogfooding builds empathy, and kindness is strategic.
fiona.zh: 2026 年初，强调 AI 时代的领导力：一对一用于实时对话，亲自使用产品（dogfooding）建立同理心，善良是战略工具。

fiona.en: Engineering bandwidth no longer bottleneck; verification, review, and coordination are. Planning becomes just-in-time.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 5 月，指出工程带宽不再是瓶颈，验证、审查和跨职能协调成为新瓶颈；规划转向即时（JIT）模式。

fiona.en: AI lifts ceiling for all; high agency with accountability key. Engineers may feel lonely; focus on outcomes.
fiona.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为 AI 提升了所有人的能力上限，高自主性与高责任感是关键；工程师可能感到孤独，应关注成果而非产出。

fadell.en: Technology should be introduced gradually so society can adapt; self-driving cars will dominate due to insurance costs.
fadell.zh: 技术应渐进引入以让社会适应；自动驾驶将因保险成本而主导。

fadell.en: Taking breaks and getting bored can lead to breakthrough ideas; self-care is foundational for performance.
fadell.zh: 休息和无聊能带来突破性想法；自我照顾是表现的基础。

fadell.en: Start with a press release to define the story; small teams thrive on self-management; optimism is cultivated.
fadell.zh: 从新闻稿开始定义故事；小团队靠自我管理；乐观是培养出来的。

fadell.en: Great ideas start with a painkiller, not a vitamin; v1 decisions are opinion-based; experts can hinder innovation.
fadell.zh: 好想法始于止痛药而非维生素；初版决策基于观点；专家可能阻碍创新。

fadell.en: AI needs context from sensors; future devices will be companions to smartphones, not replacements; platforms are not businesses.
fadell.zh: AI 需要传感器上下文；未来设备是智能手机的伴侣而非替代；平台不是业务。

dario.en: Scaling laws are empirical; alignment not guaranteed by scaling alone. Safety research needs frontier models.
dario.zh: 缩放定律是经验性的，仅靠规模扩张无法保证对齐。安全研究需要前沿模型。

dario.en: Interpretability is nascent (3% understood); AGI is a smooth exponential, not a single point. Post-training gains importance.
dario.zh: 可解释性尚处萌芽（仅理解 3%）；AGI 是平滑指数曲线而非单一节点。后训练重要性上升。

dario.en: AI progress exponential; risks from misuse and overheating. Open source is a red herring; model quality matters.
dario.zh: AI 进展呈指数级；风险来自滥用和过热。开源是伪议题，模型质量才是关键。

dario.en: AI is a 'country of geniuses' not a god; exponential nearing end. Focus on enterprise, interpretability, and societal adaptation.
dario.zh: AI 是“天才之国”而非神；指数增长接近尾声。聚焦企业应用、可解释性和社会适应。

dario.en: Consistent: scaling laws drive progress; safety and capabilities intertwined; enterprise focus aligns with safety; interpretability key.
dario.zh: 一以贯之：缩放定律驱动进步；安全与能力交织；企业导向契合安全；可解释性至关重要。

ivyross.en: Design should address unarticulated needs; intuition complements data; tactile experiences remain valuable in digital companies.
ivyross.zh: 设计应满足未被言明的需求；直觉与数据互补；在数字化公司中，触觉体验仍具价值。

ivyross.en: Nature is the best designer; technology should amplify humanity; art is medicine; we have 52 senses.
ivyross.zh: 自然是最好的设计师；技术应增强人性；艺术是良药；我们有 52 种感官。

ivyross.en: Creativity thrives under constraints; leaders must create conditions for play; intuition guides decisions; combine human creativity with AI.
ivyross.zh: 创造力在约束下蓬勃发展；领导者需创造玩耍条件；直觉指导决策；将人类创造力与 AI 结合。

lecun.en: Intelligence is inseparable from learning; self-supervised learning builds world models, grounding in physical world for common sense.
lecun.zh: 智能与学习密不可分；自监督学习构建世界模型，物理世界的基础对常识至关重要。

lecun.en: Self-supervised learning is dark matter of intelligence; prediction via filling blanks; world models learned, not hardwired.
lecun.zh: 自监督学习是智能的暗物质；通过填空预测；世界模型是习得的，而非硬编码。

lecun.en: Autoregressive LLMs lack world understanding; JEPA for abstract representations; open source crucial; AGI gradual.
lecun.zh: 自回归 LLM 缺乏世界理解；JEPA 用于抽象表征；开源至关重要；AGI 是渐进过程。

lecun.en: LLMs less intelligent than cat; world models enable reasoning/planning; human-level AI in 10 years; open source enabler.
lecun.zh: LLM 不如猫聪明；世界模型实现推理/规划；十年内达到人类级 AI；开源是赋能者。

lecun.en: World models predict in abstract space; LLMs dead end; objective-driven AI safer; open research essential.
lecun.zh: 世界模型在抽象空间预测；LLM 是死胡同；目标驱动 AI 更安全；开放研究至关重要。

suleyman.en: AI progress is predictable due to compute scaling; Google had ChatGPT-level tech in 2020 but didn't launch.
suleyman.zh: 2023 年，苏莱曼认为 AI 进展因算力扩张而可预测；谷歌 2020 年就有 ChatGPT 级技术，但因保守未发布。

suleyman.en: AI will reach human-level in 3-5 years; existential risk is tiny; singularity is far away.
suleyman.zh: 2024 年，他预测 AI 将在 3-5 年内达到人类水平；存在性风险极小；奇点还很遥远。

suleyman.en: AI should not claim consciousness; containment and alignment are crucial before superintelligence.
suleyman.zh: 2025 年，他强调 AI 不应声称有意识；在超级智能前必须遏制和对齐。

suleyman.en: Superintelligence is near; Microsoft must build own frontier models; focus on humanist AI.
suleyman.zh: 2026 年，他认为超级智能临近；微软需自建前沿模型；聚焦人本主义 AI。

gustav.en: Internet shifts from curation to recommendation to generation; AI DJ is a true generative product.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，互联网从策展转向推荐再到生成；AI DJ 是真正的生成式产品。

gustav.en: Autonomy should sit at VP level, not leaves or top, balancing speed and coherence.
gustav.zh: 2023 年，自主权应放在副总裁层级，而非基层或顶层，以平衡速度与一致性。

gustav.en: Strong opinions loosely held: believe 100% until data says no, then change 100%.
gustav.zh: 2023 至 2026 年，坚持“强烈观点但宽松持有”：百分百相信，直到数据否定，然后彻底改变。

gustav.en: No single right org model; choose one fitting personality and optimize for what matters.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，没有唯一正确的组织模式；选择适合个性的，并优化最重要的。

gustav.en: Generative AI gives users control via plain English; prioritize well-being over engagement.
gustav.zh: 2026 年，生成式 AI 通过自然语言赋予用户控制权；优先用户福祉而非参与度。

carinahong.en: Scaling informal models to math AI is not viable; formal verification is essential for sound proofs.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，提出仅靠扩展非正式模型无法实现数学 AI，形式化验证对可靠证明至关重要。

carinahong.en: Auto-formalization is harder than proving; correctly formalizing statements without solutions is challenging.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 2 月，指出自动形式化比证明更难，在没有解的情况下正确形式化命题极具挑战。

carinahong.en: Formal verification is about scaling brilliance, not just eliminating errors; it yields performance gains.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，强调形式化验证旨在扩展智慧而非仅消除错误，能带来性能提升。

carinahong.en: Informal math systems alone cannot scale to superintelligence; formal methods are necessary.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，重申非正式数学系统无法扩展到超级智能，必须依赖形式化方法。

carinahong.en: Human taste and intuition remain crucial even with superhuman AI proving theorems.
carinahong.zh: 2026 年 6 月，认为即使 AI 能证明定理，人类的品味和直觉仍不可或缺。

satya.en: AI is the future of the firm; every enterprise must build its own hill-climbing machine to compound token capital.
satya.zh: AI 是企业的未来；每家企业都必须构建自己的爬山机器，以复利积累 token 资本。

satya.en: Private evals are the biggest IP, more valuable than models or data; every company should hill-climb on frontier models.
satya.zh: 私有评估是最重要的知识产权，比模型或数据更有价值；每家公司都应在前沿模型上爬山。

satya.en: Per-user pricing is an artifact of budget certainty; consumption pricing will grow, and outcome-based pricing is preferred.
satya.zh: 按用户定价是预算确定性的产物；消费定价将增长，基于结果的定价更受青睐。

satya.en: The biggest risk is tacit knowledge leaking from enterprises via AI training; security and containment are critical.
satya.zh: 最大的风险是企业隐性知识通过 AI 训练泄露；安全与遏制至关重要。

satya.en: Sovereign AI is best achieved by enabling companies to hill-climb, not by building firewalls; global GDP could compound at 10%.
satya.zh: 主权 AI 的最佳实现方式是让企业爬山，而非建立防火墙；全球 GDP 可能以 10% 复利增长。

murati.en: Early on, scaling laws and focusing on one large model were not obvious; releasing GPT-3 as API was a leap of faith.
murati.zh: 早期，缩放定律和专注于单一大型模型并非显而易见；将 GPT-3 作为 API 发布是一次信仰之跃。

murati.en: Deploying AI in real world is essential for learning and alignment; safety work must be done in public.
murati.zh: 在现实世界中部署 AI 对于学习和对齐至关重要；安全工作必须在公开场合进行。

murati.en: Shift from turn-based to interaction models enabling real-time, high-bandwidth human-AI collaboration.
murati.zh: 从回合制转向交互模型，实现实时、高带宽的人机协作。

murati.en: Emphasis on institutional design, transparency, and checks and balances over individual character for AI governance.
murati.zh: 强调制度设计、透明度和制衡，而非个人品格，对于 AI 治理更为重要。

murati.en: Future is not predestined; we have agency to steer AI toward collaboration, keeping humans in loop as long as possible.
murati.zh: 未来并非注定；我们有能力引导 AI 走向协作，尽可能让人类参与其中。

kaiser.en: AI progress follows smooth exponential growth; pre-training scaling laws still hold, but reasoning models offer more gains per compute.
kaiser.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AI 进展呈平滑指数增长，预训练缩放定律仍有效，但推理模型在单位算力上带来更多收益。

kaiser.en: Post-training improvements like RL and synthetic data drive most recent model gains; economic pressure shifts focus to smaller, cheaper models.
kaiser.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，我强调后训练（如强化学习和合成数据）驱动了近期模型进步，而经济压力使焦点转向更小更便宜的模型。

kaiser.en: Reasoning, RL, and tools enable solving hard problems, but generalization remains jagged; models still fail at simple tasks.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为推理、强化学习和工具能解决难题，但泛化仍呈锯齿状，模型在简单任务上仍会失败。

kaiser.en: Coding agents boost researcher productivity 5-10x; hardware progress democratizes AI experimentation at single-GPU scale.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我指出编码智能体将研究者效率提升 5-10 倍，硬件进步使单 GPU 规模的 AI 实验民主化。

kaiser.en: Near-term risks like system hacking are more pressing than existential risk; open source models persist for sovereignty reasons.
kaiser.zh: 2026 年，我认为系统入侵等近期风险比存在风险更紧迫；开源模型因主权原因将持续存在。

felixrieseberg.en: Initially, AI's value lies in local access and tool use; scaffolding may fade as models improve.
felixrieseberg.zh: 最初，AI 的价值在于本地访问和工具使用；随着模型改进，脚手架可能逐渐消失。

felixrieseberg.en: Emphasized shared tools over hyper-personalization; local computers undervalued by Silicon Valley.
felixrieseberg.zh: 强调共享工具而非超个性化；硅谷低估了本地计算机的价值。

felixrieseberg.en: Shifted focus to AI handling tedious tasks; biggest gap is user understanding, not capability.
felixrieseberg.zh: 转向关注 AI 处理繁琐任务；最大差距在于用户理解而非能力。

felixrieseberg.en: Advocated asynchronous interaction and judging by impact, not supervision; debugging workflows with AI.
felixrieseberg.zh: 提倡异步交互和以结果评判，而非监督；与 AI 一起调试工作流。

felixrieseberg.en: Noted kids excel with AI due to lack of learned constraints; custom hardware accessible.
felixrieseberg.zh: 指出孩子因未学会限制而擅长使用 AI；定制硬件变得容易。

mensch.en: Smaller models can be performant and cost-effective; data quality is critical; open source enables scrutiny and safety.
mensch.zh: 2023 年，认为小模型也能高效且经济，数据质量至关重要，开源通过审查提升安全性。

mensch.en: Efficiency gains and data quality are as important as compute; value shifts to applications and enterprise adoption.
mensch.zh: 2024 年，强调效率提升和数据质量与算力同等重要，价值向应用层和企业采用转移。

mensch.en: AI is an opportunity; sovereign AI requires control over data and infrastructure; open source empowers enterprises.
mensch.zh: 2025 年，视 AI 为机遇，主权 AI 需掌控数据和基础设施，开源赋能企业。

mensch.en: Models commoditize; differentiation in downstream apps; pre-training saturation; vertical specialization and enterprise integration.
mensch.zh: 2026 年，模型商品化，差异化在下游应用；预训练饱和，转向垂直专业化和企业集成。

mensch.en: Europe needs strategic autonomy in AI; deep enterprise engagement; open source for sovereignty; AGI is a direction, not destination.
mensch.zh: 2026 年及以后，欧洲需 AI 战略自主，深度企业参与，开源保主权；AGI 是方向而非终点。

reinerpope.en: Inference cost is dominated by memory bandwidth, not compute; batch size trades latency vs cost.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：推理成本主要由内存带宽而非算力决定；批大小是权衡延迟与成本的关键杠杆。

reinerpope.en: Models are overtrained ~100x beyond Chinchilla-optimal due to inference cost; context length limited by memory wall.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 4 月：由于推理成本，模型过度训练约 100 倍于 Chinchilla 最优；上下文长度受内存墙限制而非算力。

reinerpope.en: Data movement dominates compute even inside chips; systolic arrays and scratchpad reduce overhead.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：即使在芯片内部，数据搬运也主导算力；脉动阵列和暂存器减少开销。

reinerpope.en: Low precision (FP4) yields 3x throughput over FP8 due to quadratic scaling with bit width.
reinerpope.zh: 2026 年 5 月：低精度（FP4）因位宽二次方缩放，吞吐量是 FP8 的 3 倍。

reinerpope.en: Memory bandwidth and data movement are the core bottlenecks across inference and chip design.
reinerpope.zh: 始终：内存带宽和数据搬运是推理与芯片设计的核心瓶颈。

oriol.en: Two-phase training (pre-training imitation + post-training RL) is the constant core across AlphaGo, AlphaStar, and modern LLMs.
oriol.zh: 两阶段训练（预训练模仿 + 后训练强化学习）是贯穿 AlphaGo、AlphaStar 和现代大语言模型的不变核心。

oriol.en: Scaling pre-training shows diminishing returns; further progress needs algorithmic innovation, not just bigger models.
oriol.zh: 预训练的 Scaling（规模扩张）收益递减；进一步进展需要算法创新，而不仅仅是更大的模型。

oriol.en: Inference-time compute (thinking) is a new scaling axis that can improve reasoning and break pre-training limits.
oriol.zh: 推理时算力（思考）是新的 Scaling（规模扩张）轴，可提升推理能力并突破预训练限制。

oriol.en: World models that jointly model language, vision, and video are a core path to AGI.
oriol.zh: 联合建模语言、视觉和视频的世界模型是通往 AGI（通用人工智能）的核心路径。

oriol.en: Memory for agents will be solved via non-parametric file-system style storage, not weight updates.
oriol.zh: 智能体的记忆将通过非参数的文件系统式存储解决，而非权重更新。

jonyive.en: Design is driven by values and purpose, not profit; simplicity requires joy and humanity, not just minimalism.
jonyive.zh: 设计应由价值观和目的驱动，而非利润；简约需要愉悦和人性，而非仅仅极简。

jonyive.en: Virtual communication cannot replace in-person presence for creative thinking; curiosity must be protected from being educated out.
jonyive.zh: 虚拟交流无法替代面对面交流对创造性思维的作用；好奇心必须被保护，以免被教育扼杀。

jonyive.en: Innovation should move things forward, not break for the sake of breaking; design teams must foster trust to protect fragile ideas.
jonyive.zh: 创新应推动事物前进，而非为破坏而破坏；设计团队必须培养信任以保护脆弱的想法。

jonyive.en: Tradition is preserving fire, not worshiping ashes; electric powertrains turn constraints into new design opportunities.
jonyive.zh: 传统是保存火种，而非崇拜灰烬；电动动力系统将约束转化为新的设计机会。

jonyive.en: Authenticity in user experience matters; mimicking combustion sounds is fake; performance is multidimensional, not just speed.
jonyive.zh: 用户体验的真实性很重要；模仿内燃机声音是虚假的；性能是多维的，不仅仅是速度。

jennywen.en: Traditional design process is outdated; trust intuition and craft over rigid steps.
jennywen.zh: 传统设计流程已过时；应信任直觉与手艺，而非僵化步骤。

jennywen.en: Design process is dead; designers must build, ship fast, and adapt to 3-6 month horizons.
jennywen.zh: 设计流程已死；设计师必须快速构建、交付，并适应 3-6 个月的视野。

jennywen.en: Designers should adopt new archetypes, prioritize judgment, and resist AI hype.
jennywen.zh: 设计师应采用新原型，优先判断力，并抵制 AI 炒作。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid robots are the biggest business; key is solving intelligence, not manufacturing.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 4 月：人形机器人是最大的商业机会，关键在于解决智能问题，而非制造问题。

brettadcock.en: Data, not compute or manufacturing, is the biggest constraint for humanoid robots.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：数据而非算力或制造，是人形机器人最大的瓶颈。

brettadcock.en: Humanoid form enables transfer learning; on-device inference critical for real-world deployment.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：人形形态促进迁移学习；端侧推理对实际部署至关重要。

brettadcock.en: Figure 4 designed around data and Helix 3, aiming for iPhone-like moment.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：Figure 4 围绕数据和 Helix 3 设计，目标是 iPhone 式时刻。

brettadcock.en: Robot hand parity with human hand is fundamental for general-purpose robots.
brettadcock.zh: 2026 年 5 月：机器人手与人类手对齐是通用机器人的基础。

lambert.en: RLHF is the most popular fine-tuning technique and will persist due to industry investment. Openness is crucial to prevent corporate capture.
lambert.zh: 2024 年，RLHF 是最流行的微调技术，并因行业投入而持续。开放性对防止企业垄断至关重要。

lambert.en: Data quality matters more than algorithm choice; post-training has three stages: SFT, DPO, and RL with verifiable rewards.
lambert.zh: 2024 至 2025 年，数据质量比算法选择更重要；后训练分为 SFT、DPO 和基于可验证奖励的强化学习三个阶段。

lambert.en: RLVR is the biggest post-training breakthrough, enabling reasoning and tool use; hybrid reasoning models may be temporary.
lambert.zh: 2025 年，RLVR 是后训练最大突破，支持推理和工具使用；混合推理模型可能是暂时的。

lambert.en: Open models will be the engine for AI research for the next decade, but they lag 6-9 months behind closed frontier models.
lambert.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，开放模型将成为未来十年 AI 研究的引擎，但落后闭源前沿模型 6-9 个月。

lambert.en: Pre-training scaling laws still hold, but gains now come from post-training and inference scaling; Chinese labs focus on engineering execution.
lambert.zh: 2026 年，预训练缩放定律仍成立，但收益来自后训练和推理扩展；中国实验室注重工程执行。

kendall.en: End-to-end deep learning outperforms hand-coded stacks; hybrid systems get worst of both worlds.
kendall.zh: 端到端深度学习优于手工编码栈；混合系统往往两头不讨好。

kendall.en: World models enable reasoning and emergent safe behaviors, like nudging forward on blind turns.
kendall.zh: 世界模型支持推理和涌现的安全行为，例如在盲弯处前移试探。

kendall.en: Language integration improves representation, enables human interaction, and aids introspection.
kendall.zh: 语言集成改善表征、促进人机交互，并有助于内省。

kendall.en: Autonomous driving is fundamentally an AI problem best solved with end-to-end learning.
kendall.zh: 自动驾驶本质上是 AI 问题，最好用端到端学习解决。

kendall.en: Infrastructure and data quality are more critical than algorithmic innovation for deep learning.
kendall.zh: 对于深度学习，基础设施和数据质量比算法创新更关键。

pathak.en: Generalization beyond training distribution is key; curiosity-driven exploration prevents overfitting and enables better generalization.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，强调超越训练分布的泛化是关键；好奇心驱动的探索能防止过拟合，实现更好的泛化。

pathak.en: Model disagreement as intrinsic reward enables differentiable curiosity, improving sample efficiency in robot learning.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，提出将模型分歧作为内在奖励，实现可微好奇心，提升机器人学习的样本效率。

pathak.en: Current robot learning is quasi-static; neural dynamic policies embed trajectory structure for smooth, dynamic motion.
pathak.zh: 2020 年，指出当前机器人学习是准静态的；神经动态策略通过嵌入轨迹结构实现平滑动态运动。

pathak.en: Robotics is a data problem; no internet of robot data, so use all sources; pretrain on diverse data, post-train on real.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，认为机器人学是数据问题；没有机器人数据的互联网，需利用所有数据源；在多样化数据上预训练，在真实数据上后训练。

pathak.en: Deployment is primary challenge; unlike language models, robotics cannot scale like software; needs rigorous testing.
pathak.zh: 2026 年，强调部署是首要挑战；与语言模型不同，机器人不能像软件一样扩展；需要严格测试。

pachocki.en: AGI is a sequence of milestones, not a single event; scaling reasoning models will accelerate progress.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他认为 AGI 是一系列里程碑而非单一事件，且扩展推理模型将加速进展。

pachocki.en: AI alignment is pressing; iterative deployment helps learn and mitigate real-world risks.
pachocki.zh: 2025 年，他强调对齐的紧迫性，并认为迭代部署有助于在现实应用中学习和缓解风险。

pachocki.en: Continual learning via scaling pre-training and RL is the core goal; chain-of-thought monitoring aids alignment.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他提出通过扩展预训练和强化学习实现持续学习是核心目标，思维链监控有助于对齐。

pachocki.en: Models will soon work autonomously for days, requiring new supervision paradigms; power concentration is key risk.
pachocki.zh: 2026 年，他预测模型将自主运行数天，需要新的监督范式，并指出权力集中是主要风险。

karpathy.en: Transformers are general-purpose differentiable computers; scaling with next-token prediction yields emergent abilities like in-context learning.
karpathy.zh: Transformer 是通用可微计算机；通过下一个词预测进行 Scaling（规模扩张）会产生涌现能力，如上下文内学习。

karpathy.en: Synthetic data is future but must maintain entropy; Tesla's end-to-end approach is right; humanoid robots benefit from car transfer.
karpathy.zh: 合成数据是未来，但需保持熵；特斯拉端到端方法正确；人形机器人受益于汽车迁移学习。

karpathy.en: Software 3.0: LLMs as OS, prompts as programs; decade of agents, not year; vibe coding raises floor.
karpathy.zh: 软件 3.0：LLM 如操作系统，提示词如程序；这是智能体的十年而非一年；氛围编程提高入门门槛。

karpathy.en: We're summoning ghosts, not building animals; LLMs are jagged, need cognitive core stripped of memory; RL is terrible.
karpathy.zh: 我们召唤的是幽灵而非构建动物；LLM 能力参差不齐，需剥离记忆的认知核心；强化学习效果糟糕。

karpathy.en: I haven't typed code since December; agentic engineering: outsource thinking but not understanding; verifiability drives automation.
karpathy.zh: 自去年 12 月起我未再手写代码；智能体工程：可外包思考但不可外包理解；可验证性驱动自动化。

carlpei.en: Building a brand unites teams on a higher purpose; survival is core for startups.
carlpei.zh: 2022 年，Carl Pei 强调品牌建设是团队围绕更高目标团结一致的核心，而生存是初创企业的首要价值观。

carlpei.en: Smartphone future lies in generative UI and agentic software, not hardware; AI commoditizing.
carlpei.zh: 2025 年，他认为手机的未来在于生成式界面和智能体式软件，而非硬件；同时指出 AI 模型正趋于商品化，价格战不可避免。

carlpei.en: AI should be an ingredient for user experience, not a hype topic; focus on utility.
carlpei.zh: 2025 至 2026 年间，他持续强调 AI 应作为提升用户体验的要素而非营销噱头，主张聚焦实际效用，避免空谈概念。

carlpei.en: Design is the fastest differentiator in mature categories; smartphones won't be replaced by glasses.
carlpei.zh: 2026 年，他重申设计是成熟品类中最快的差异化手段，并明确表示智能手机不会被眼镜等可穿戴设备取代，除非出现脑机接口。

carlpei.en: Content creation and marketing arbitrage are key advantages for challenger brands.
carlpei.zh: 从 2022 年到 2026 年，他始终认为内容创作和营销套利是挑战者品牌（如 Nothing）以小博大的关键优势。

turley.en: Model is the product; iterate like software, ship daily to learn user needs.
turley.zh: 模型即产品，要像软件一样迭代，每日发布以了解用户需求。

turley.en: Chat is not the end; future interface will be more than turn-by-turn chat.
turley.zh: 聊天不是终点，未来界面将超越逐轮对话。

turley.en: Safety and product velocity must be separated; rigorous for frontier models, fast for products.
turley.zh: 安全与产品速度必须分离；前沿模型严格，产品开发加速。

turley.en: North star is long-term retention; growth from friction removal, product, model.
turley.zh: 北极星是长期留存；增长来自消除摩擦、产品与模型。

turley.en: Next billion users need proactive, affordance-rich products beyond chatbots.
turley.zh: 下一个十亿用户需要主动且功能丰富的产品，而非聊天机器人。

edwinchen.en: AGI is a decade or more away; moving from 80% to 99.9% performance is hard. New paradigms beyond next-token prediction are needed.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 年，我认为 AGI（通用人工智能）至少还需十年以上，因为从 80%到 99.9%的性能提升极其困难。仅靠下一个词预测无法达到 AGI（通用人工智能），需要新的学习范式。

edwinchen.en: Benchmarks like Elo are misleading and gameable; real progress needs deep human evals. Optimizing for them leads to 'slop'.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我持续强调 Elo 等基准具有误导性且易被钻空子，真正的进步需要深度人工评估。为基准优化会导致模型输出“垃圾内容”。

edwinchen.en: Reinforcement learning environments are the next stage of post-training, simulating real-world tasks for models to learn from.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我认为强化学习环境是后训练的下一个阶段，通过模拟真实任务让模型学习。

edwinchen.en: Frontier labs diverge in objective functions, shaping diverse AIs. Eventually every company should train its own models to align with its thesis.
edwinchen.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我观察到前沿实验室因目标函数不同而塑造出多样化的 AI。最终每家公司都应训练自己的模型以契合其独特理念。

edwinchen.en: In medicine, AI can hallucinate; human judgment is critical. AI tools may underperform AI alone due to anchoring and sycophancy. Safety over accuracy.
edwinchen.zh: 2026 年，在医学领域，AI 可能产生幻觉，人类判断至关重要。医生使用 AI 工具可能因锚定和谄媚效应而表现不如单独使用 AI。应优先考虑安全而非准确性。

kohli.en: AI in science should target root-node problems, not narrow applications, for broad impact.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他强调 AI 在科学中应解决根本性问题而非狭窄应用，以产生广泛影响。

kohli.en: LLM hallucinations can be harnessed for creative discovery when paired with truth detectors.
kohli.zh: 2024 年，他认为大语言模型的幻觉在配合真值检测器时，可被用于创造性发现。

kohli.en: Large language models are a shortcut to intelligence but struggle to go beyond human data.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他指出大语言模型是智能的捷径，但难以超越人类数据。

kohli.en: Post-training with reinforcement learning is now key to pushing beyond human knowledge.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他认为基于强化学习的后训练是超越人类知识的关键。

kohli.en: Interpretability is important but not essential for scientific breakthroughs like AlphaFold.
kohli.zh: 2026 年，他坚持可解释性重要，但对 AlphaFold 这类科学突破并非必需。

jimfan.en: Embodiment is critical for grounding AI and reducing hallucinations; LLMs lack grounded experience.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，强调具身对 AI 落地和减少幻觉至关重要，LLM 缺乏具身体验。

jimfan.en: Internet tokens are running out; embodied worlds provide infinite data for pre-training.
jimfan.zh: 2023 年，认为互联网 token 即将耗尽，具身世界提供无限数据用于预训练。

jimfan.en: Data bottleneck in robotics; synthetic data from simulation and world models is the future.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，指出机器人数据瓶颈，合成数据（仿真+世界模型）是未来。

jimfan.en: Physical Turing test (robot cleaning messy house) is grand challenge for embodied AI.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，将物理图灵测试（机器人打扫凌乱房间）视为具身 AI 的终极挑战。

jimfan.en: Robot foundation models via simple end-to-end learning from diverse data; GPT-3 moment in ~5 years.
jimfan.zh: 2026 年，主张通过简单端到端模型利用多样数据构建机器人基础模型，预计约 5 年后迎来机器人领域的 GPT-3 时刻。

nando.en: AI should augment human capabilities; learning from video and generalist agents are promising paths toward AGI.
nando.zh: 2023 年，强调 AI 应像显微镜一样扩展人类能力，从视频学习和通用智能体是通向 AGI 的可行路径。

nando.en: AI safety is the biggest open challenge; Africa can leapfrog legacy issues and contribute uniquely to AI.
nando.zh: 2026 年，认为 AI 安全是最大未解难题；非洲可跳过遗留问题，为 AI 做出独特贡献。

nando.en: Diversity and inclusion are essential for building beneficial AI; human skills complement technical ones.
nando.zh: 始终强调多样性和包容性对构建有益 AI 至关重要，人文技能与技术技能相辅相成。

nando.en: From excitement about scaling and generalist agents to prioritizing safety and responsible deployment.
nando.zh: 从 2023 年对规模扩张和通用智能体的兴奋，转向 2026 年优先考虑安全与负责任部署。

nando.en: Fundamental innovation can come from anywhere; research requires embracing failure and simplifying problems.
nando.zh: 始终认为根本性创新可来自任何地方；研究需拥抱失败并简化问题。

sholto.en: Long context windows are underhyped; in-context learning resembles gradient descent, boosting intelligence.
sholto.zh: 2024 年，我认为长上下文被低估了，上下文内学习类似梯度下降，能显著提升模型智能。

sholto.en: RL from verifiable rewards is the key breakthrough; pre-training plus RL may suffice for AGI.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我强调基于可验证奖励的强化学习是关键突破，预训练加强化学习可能足以实现 AGI。

sholto.en: Agent reliability, not capability, is the main bottleneck; coding is the leading indicator.
sholto.zh: 2025 年，我认为智能体的可靠性而非能力是主要瓶颈，编程是 AI 进步的先导指标。

sholto.en: RL is a new scaling axis; longer agentic coherence expands achievable tasks dramatically.
sholto.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我将强化学习视为新的扩展轴，更长的智能体连贯性大幅扩展了可完成任务的范围。

sholto.en: Capability overhang means tools and orchestration matter more; compute is the new oil.
sholto.zh: 2026 年，我认为能力过剩使得工具和编排比原始智能更重要，算力成为新石油。

nadchishtie.en: Designers should enable engineers, not bottleneck; AI as creative partner; code as source of truth.
nadchishtie.zh: 设计师应赋能工程师而非成为瓶颈；将 AI 视为创意伙伴；代码为最终真相。

nadchishtie.en: Generalists owning end-to-end execution with AI are most valuable; portfolios show craft, not process.
nadchishtie.zh: 掌握端到端执行并用 AI 补足短板的通才最受青睐；作品集展示工艺而非流程。

nadchishtie.en: Small cross-functional teams outperform larger squads; generalists beat specialists in AI-first companies.
nadchishtie.zh: 小型跨职能团队优于大团队；在 AI 优先的公司中通才胜过专才。

nadchishtie.en: Using AI in core workflows is now expected; ignoring it is like ignoring early internet.
nadchishtie.zh: 在核心工作流中使用 AI 已成为常态；忽视它如同早期忽视互联网。

henrymodisett.en: Designers should code to build empathy and ship faster; prioritize speed and familiarity over perfection.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计师应会编码以建立同理心并加快交付；优先追求速度和熟悉度，而非完美。

henrymodisett.en: Brand is a strategic weapon for recruiting and differentiation; invest early and make it dynamic.
henrymodisett.zh: 品牌是招聘和差异化的战略武器；早期投入并保持动态。

henrymodisett.en: Velocity at all costs: empower designers, make gut decisions, and avoid rigid processes.
henrymodisett.zh: 不惜一切代价追求速度：赋能设计师，凭直觉决策，避免僵化流程。

henrymodisett.en: Hire diverse archetypes, not clones; give ownership and autonomy to grow talent.
henrymodisett.zh: 招聘多元原型而非克隆；给予所有权和自主权以培养人才。

henrymodisett.en: Design process should adapt to the problem; organic feedback beats structured crits.
henrymodisett.zh: 设计流程应因问题而异；有机反馈优于结构化评审。

yejin.en: Scaling alone may not solve common sense; smaller models with better algorithms and data can outperform larger ones.
yejin.zh: 2023 年，我认为仅靠 Scaling（规模扩张）可能无法解决常识问题；通过更好的算法和数据，较小的模型可以超越较大的模型。

yejin.en: Pre-training and post-training are both crucial; RLHF is key for safe responses, but data is the fundamental bottleneck.
yejin.zh: 从 2023 年到 2025 年，我始终强调预训练和后训练都至关重要，基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）对安全响应很关键，但数据是根本瓶颈。

yejin.en: Current AI interpolates human knowledge; abductive reasoning and falsification are key for scientific discovery beyond induction.
yejin.zh: 2025 年，我认为当前 AI 只是内插人类知识；溯因推理和证伪对于超越归纳的科学发现至关重要。

yejin.en: Reinforcement learning during pre-training improves reasoning; RLVR can decrease pass@k even as best-of-n improves.
yejin.zh: 2025 至 2026 年，我提出在预训练阶段引入强化学习可提升推理能力；同时发现 RLVR 可能降低 pass@k，即使 best-of-n 有所提升。

yejin.en: Pluralistic alignment respects diverse values; small models with diverse synthetic data can match frontier models.
yejin.zh: 2026 年，我主张多元对齐以尊重不同价值观；通过多样化的合成数据，小模型也能媲美前沿模型。

shazeer.en: Scaling models with more compute and data leads to smarter AI; next-token prediction is AI-complete.
shazeer.zh: 2023 年，他认为通过更多算力和数据扩展模型规模能带来更智能的 AI，并强调下一个词预测是 AI 完备的问题。

shazeer.en: Inference-time compute scaling is a major near-term opportunity; models improve via algorithmic advances and hardware scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他提出推理时算力扩展是近期重大机遇，模型进步来自算法与硬件扩展的共同驱动。

shazeer.en: Future models need trillion-token context windows; modular sparse architectures enable efficient scaling.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他认为未来模型需支持万亿级上下文窗口，模块化稀疏架构可实现高效扩展。

shazeer.en: Test-time compute scaling drives progress but alone won't achieve AGI; agentic capabilities are crucial.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他强调测试时算力扩展推动进步，但仅靠它无法实现 AGI，智能体能力至关重要。

shazeer.en: Open-source models are closing the gap with frontier models; AI will transform education and coding.
shazeer.zh: 2025 年，他指出开源模型正缩小与前沿模型的差距，AI 将变革教育与编程。

truell.en: Scaling laws predict progress; test-time compute scaling may surpass pre-training scaling as next major driver.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为缩放定律能预测进展，而测试时算力扩展可能超越预训练扩展，成为下一个主要驱动力。

truell.en: Natural language won't be primary programming method; examples and direct manipulation are better.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我提出自然语言不会成为主要编程方式，示例和直接操作更优。

truell.en: Agents are promising but not yet super useful; iterative human-AI collaboration remains central.
truell.zh: 2024 年，我认为智能体有前景但尚不实用，迭代的人机协作仍是核心。

truell.en: Programming shifts from code to intent specification; taste and logic design become more valuable.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我强调编程从代码转向意图描述，品味和逻辑设计比细心更重要。

truell.en: Custom models are essential for product quality; every magic moment in Cursor involves a custom model.
truell.zh: 2025 年，我指出定制模型对产品质量至关重要，Cursor 的每个神奇时刻都涉及定制模型。

leike.en: AI safety is crucial; empirical research is under-explored. Focus on skill building, not capability research.
leike.zh: 2018 年，强调 AI 安全至关重要，实证研究尚待开发；应专注技能培养而非能力研究。

leike.en: RLHF won't scale; need scalable oversight. Alignment may be easier than thought; use model organisms.
leike.zh: 2023 年，认为 RLHF 无法扩展，需要可扩展监督；对齐可能比想象中容易，可训练欺骗模型作为研究样本。

leike.en: OpenAI's safety culture eroded; post-training insufficient. External oversight and raising misuse cost are needed.
leike.zh: 2024 年，批评 OpenAI 安全文化退化，后训练不足以解决对齐；需外部监管并提高滥用成本。

abbeel.en: Self-play and imitation learning are strong signals for robot skill acquisition; RL needs hierarchical reasoning for long-horizon tasks.
abbeel.zh: 2018 年，强调自对弈和模仿学习为机器人技能获取提供强信号；强化学习需分层推理以解决长时程任务。

abbeel.en: Combining unsupervised learning with RL improves sample efficiency; hard-coding prior knowledge can limit performance.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，主张无监督学习与强化学习结合以提升样本效率；硬编码先验知识可能限制性能。

abbeel.en: Pre-trained language models transfer general reasoning to non-language tasks; brain-inspired generality remains distant.
abbeel.zh: 2021 年，指出预训练语言模型可将通用推理迁移至非语言任务；但类脑通用性仍遥远。
